具体职责  
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 组织建立安全管理体系，批准安全管理体系文件及其它相关文件；组织制定和发布公司
的安全和环境保护方针和目标；对安全和防污染工作负总责。 
To organize  and establish the Company’s safety management system and approve its documents and 
other relevant documents accordingly; to develop and publish the Company’s safety and environmental 
protection policies and objectives, and take the overall responsibility for its  management of safety and 
pollution prevention. 
2. 任命指定人员，授权其监控船岸的安全和防污染工作，保证公司安全管理体系的有效运
行和持续改进。 
To appoint DP and authorize the DP to monitor the safety and pollution prevention on the ship and shore so 
as to ensure the effective operation and continuous improvement of the Company's safety management 
system. 
3. 发布船长绝对权力的声明，提供足够的资源和岸基支持，确保船长能够有效地履行其职
责。 
To release master's declaration of absolute power, providing the ship with adequate resources and 
shore-based support so as to ensure the master to fulfill his/her duties and responsibilities effectively. 
4. 组织安全管理有效性评价和管理复查。 
主持重大事故纠正措施的评审，主持管理体系定期评价会议或管理复查会议，批准管理
体系评价或复查报告，决定是否实施管理复查。 
To organize effectiveness evaluation and review on the safety management. 
To chair the review of major accident corrective measures and the regular evaluations of management 
system or management reviews, approving their reports, so as to decide to implement the management 
review accordingly. 
5. 当船舶发生紧急情况时，任抢险总指挥，组织抢险工作。 
To assume the emergency commander and organize the rescue work upon the ship emergency. 
6. 对港口国检查、船旗国检查的管理工作进行检查、控制。 
To implement the management on port state control and flag state inspection. 
7. 定期向总裁汇报有关公司管理经营情况  
To report to the president about the management and operation of the Company regularly.  
8. 学习与交流活动 
了解和学习外界同行的先进经验，推进对外交流合作 
Learning and exchange 
To learn advanced experience from outside colleagues and promote foreign exchanges and cooperation.

To review the safety management system documentary of ISM Department, ensuring the 
conformity and effectiveness of the edition and revision.

监督和指导体系主管的工作，安排审核员登轮检查，对检查的方式方法提出指导性意

To supervise and review the safety management system 
Critical process: to supervise and instruct the system supervisor, to arrange the auditor to 
conduct onboard inspection, and put forward guidance to the inspection; to coordinate the 
external audit arrangement and propose additional internal audit to DP as required.

督促指导公司保安员的工作；计划并实施船舶保安评估和审核；协调保安外审安排。 
To supervise the security of the Company and ships. 
Supervise and instruct the work of the Company's security officers; plan and implement the ship security

Critical process: to be engaged in the Company's emergency response, and organize the relevant personnel 
to provide support to the emergency response. 
8、学习与交流活动。 
了解和学习外界同行的先进经验，推进对外交流合作。 
Learning and exchange 
To learn advanced experience from outside colleagues, and promote foreign exchange and cooperation. 
9、完成总经理交办的其他工作。 
To complete other tasks assigned by GM.

替代关系 
Substitutability 
主管海务副总经理 
Vice-General Manager (VGM) of Marine Department 
具体职责 
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 对公司船舶的海务安全和公司体系的维护运行负责,协助防污染工作、人身安全和劳动
保护工作、PSC/FSC/RIGHT SHIP/P&I 等外部检查工作。 
To be responsible for the safety of the Company’s ships and the operation of the Company's safety system, 
assisting in pollution prevention, personal safety, labor protection and external inspections such as 
PSC/FSC/RIGHT SHIP/P&I, etc. 
2. 公司、船舶保安工作 
关键流程：作为船舶保安工作的负责人，督促指导公司保安员的工作；计划并实施船舶
保安评估和审核；协调保安外审安排。 
Security of the Company and ships 
Critical process: As the head in charge of the ship security, supervise and instruct the work of the 
Company's security officers; plan and implement the ship security assessment and review, and coordinate 
external security audit arrangement. 
3. 日常管理监督 
关键流程：关注公司日常管理中的重点问题的解决情况；向主管副总经理汇报船舶安全
生产中遇到的重大问题和信息；检查部门人员对船舶登轮准备的安排和跟踪情况。对检
查发现的缺陷指定公司相关部门给予必要支持。 
Daily management and supervision 
Critical process: to give consideration to the settlement of the key problems in the Company's daily 
management, to report to the VGM the major issues and information in the ship management and 
production, and to check the arrangement and follow-up of the supervision personnel to conduct onboard 
inspection. To assign the relevant departments to provide necessary support to correct defects in inspection. 
4. 管理体系的日常维护 
关键流程：组织本部门负责的程序文件、应急计划、管理须知的修改；标明本部门业务
有关的关键性船上操作方案；负责组织起草并向船舶提供本部门有关的船舶单项操作手
册和记录簿；复核各部门外来文件的评估与发放申请； 
Daily maintenance of the management system 
Critical process: to organize the revision of the procedure documents, emergency plans and management 
notices of the department, to indicate the plans for the relevant and key onboard operation of the 
department, to be responsible for organizing developing and providing the relevant single operation manual 
and record book of the department to the ships, to review the evaluation and releasing application of the 
external document from each department.  

34

5. 本部门日常工作 
关键流程：负责本部门的季度自查；根据需要制定本部门相应的管理规定。定期检查本
部门人员的工作情况；编制、更新本部门的记录清单。 
Daily work of the department 
Critical process: to be responsible for the quarterly inspection of the department and to develop the relevant 
management regulations of the department according to the relevant management regulations. To conduct a 
regular inspection on the work of the staff of the department, and to develop and update the recording list 
of the department. 
6. 文件管理 
关键流程：负责本部门主管业务范围内的外来文件的符合性和组织发放。作为本部门文
件的持有人，负责本部门体系文件的接收、保管和修订的控制；负责销毁作废文件和记
录。 
Document management 
Critical process: responsible for the conformity of the external documents within the department's business 
scope and for organizing their releasing. As the holder of the documents of the department, to be 
responsible for receiving, keeping and revising the system documents, and responsible for destructing the 
obsolete documents and records. 
7. 船舶海务管理 
关键流程：监督、指导海务主管对船舶航线设计实施监控，给船舶提供必要的航法和操
纵指导；搜集海区气象、海况和冰情信息提供给相关船舶，监控并指导船舶防范台风和
各种恶劣天气，指导船舶采取措施避开海况恶劣和冰情严重海域。协助海损事故和险情
的调查，落实纠正措施。 
Management of marine business 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the marine supervisor to conduct monitoring on the ship routing, to 
provide necessary navigation and manipulation instructions to the ship, to gather sea area meteorological 
information, sea and ice condition, providing them to the related ships, to monitor and guide the ship 
against typhoon and all kinds of bad weather, and guide the ship to take actions to avoid bad sea conditions 
and serious sea ice conditions. To assist the investigation of average accidents and hazardous occurrences, 
implementing their corrective actions. 
8. 船舶调度 
关键流程：监督、指导船舶调度工作；跟踪、监控船舶动态表格的编制和通报到公司相
关部门；必要时将注意事项进行通报。 
Ship dispatching 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the ship dispatching, tracking and monitoring the preparation of the 
ship's dynamic form and report it to the relevant departments of the Company, with notes notified if 
necessary. 
9. 货运安全管理 
关键流程：监督、指导海务主管对船舶配积载、货物保管和装卸操作实施监控，监督危
险品、易流态货物运输操作安全。 
Safety management of shipment 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the marine supervisor to conduct monitoring on ship stowage, 
cargo storage and handling, and supervise safe handling of dangerous and flowable goods. 

35

10. 船员培训 
关键流程：组织本部门责任范围内的船员熟悉岗位职责培训，新聘管理级驾驶人员的面
试和培训； 
Crew Training 
Critical process: to organize the responsibility training of the crew in charge of the department's 
responsibilities so as to enable them to get a mastery of their job duties training, and responsible for the 
interview and training of the new employed managerial personnel. 
11. 部门内部业务学习及业务培训 
关键流程：根据本部门各岗位的培训需求，每季度制定季度在岗培训计划并组织实施；
负责本部门新聘和转岗员工的熟悉岗位职责培训；确定本部门员工的外部培训需求向行
政部提出申请。 
Internal vocational studies and business training 
Critical process: to develop quarterly on-the-job training plan and organize its implementation according to 
the position requirements of the department, to be responsible for the training of new employees and the 
transferred employees, and responsible for the approval of external training application of the department. 
12. 应急准备 
关键流程：参加公司应急反应，并组织部门相关人员对应急反应提供支持。参加公司应
急训练和船岸联合演习。 
Emergency Preparations  
Critical process: to be engaged in the Company's emergency response, and organize the relevant personnel 
to provide support to the emergency response, and to participate in the Company's emergency training and 
ship-shore joint drills. 
13. 个人技能的提升与发展 
关键流程： 不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报
个人发展需求（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术
水平。 
Promotion and development of personal skills 
Critical process: to keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the 
improvement of personal business skills and reporting the personal development requirements (i.e. training, 
communication and guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and 
constantly raising the level of business technology. 
14. 对外交流 
关键流程：保持与主管机关和外部有关单位的沟通与联系，维护良好的合作关系与交流
渠道，了解业务信息和管理活动的反馈情况，及时汇总上报主管领导。 
External exchange 
Critical process: to keep in communication and touch with the competent authority and external relevant 
units to maintain good cooperative and exchange relationship, be informed of the business information and 
feed-back of management activities, and timely sum them up and report to the competent leadership. 
15. 完成领导交办的其他临时性任务 
To complete other temporary tasks assigned by the leadership.

部门人员的工作情况；编制、更新本部门的记录清单。 
Daily work of the department 
Critical process: to be responsible for the quarterly inspection of the department and for developing the 
relevant management regulations of the department according to the relevant management regulations. To 
conduct a regular inspection on the work of the staff of the department, and to develop and update the 
recording list of the department. 
5. 文件管理 
关键流程：负责本部门主管业务范围内的外来文件的符合性和组织发放。作为本部门文
件的持有人，负责本部门体系文件的接收、保管和修订的控制；负责销毁作废文件和记
录。 
Document management 
Critical process: responsible for the conformity of the external documents within the department's business 
scope and organizing their releasing. As the holder of the documents of the department, be responsible for 
receiving, keeping and revising the system documents, and responsible for destructing the obsolete 
documents and records. 
6. 船舶海务管理 
关键流程：监督、指导海务主管对船舶航线设计实施监控，给船舶提供必要的航法和操
纵指导；搜集海区气象、海况和冰情信息提供给相关船舶，监控并指导船舶防范台风和
各种恶劣天气，指导船舶采取措施避开海况恶劣和冰情严重海域。协助海损事故和险情
的调查，落实纠正措施。 
Management of marine business 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the marine supervisor to conduct monitoring on the ship routing, to 
provide necessary navigation and manipulation instructions to the ship, to gather sea area meteorological 
information, sea and ice condition, providing them to the related ships, to monitor and guide the ship 
against typhoon and all kinds of bad weather, and guide the ship to take actions to avoid bad sea conditions 
and serious sea ice conditions. To assist the investigation of average accidents and hazardous occurrences, 

39

implementing their corrective actions accordingly. 
7. 船舶调度 
关键流程：监督、指导船舶调度工作；跟踪、监控船舶动态表格的编制和通报到公司相
关部门；必要时将注意事项进行通报。 
Ship dispatching 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the ship dispatching, tracking and monitoring the preparation of the 
ship's dynamic form and reporting it to the relevant departments, with notes notified if necessary. 
8. 货运安全管理 
关键流程：监督、指导海务主管对船舶配积载、货物保管和装卸操作实施监控，监督危
险品、易流态货物运输操作安全。 
Safety management of shipment 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the marine supervisor to conduct monitoring on ship stowage, cargo 
storage and handling, and supervise safe handling of dangerous and flowable goods. 
9. 船员培训 
关键流程：组织本部门责任范围内的船员熟悉岗位职责培训，新聘管理级驾驶人员的面
试和培训； 
Crew Training 
Critical process: to organize the responsibility training of the crew in charge of the department's 
responsibilities so as to enable them to get a mastery of their job duties training, and responsible for the 
interview and training of the new employed managerial personnel. 
10. 部门内部业务学习及业务培训 
关键流程：根据本部门各岗位的培训需求，每季度制定季度在岗培训计划并组织实施；
负责本部门新聘和转岗员工的熟悉岗位职责培训；确定本部门员工的外部培训需求向行
政部提出申请。 
Internal vocational studies and business training 
Critical process: to develop quarterly on-the-job training and organize its implementation according to the 
position requirements of the department. To be responsible for the training of new employees and the 
transferred employees, and be responsible for the approval of external training application of the 
department. 
11. 应急准备 
关键流程：参加公司应急反应，并组织部门相关人员对应急反应提供支持。参加公司应
急训练和船岸联合演习。 
Emergency Preparations 
Critical process: to be engaged in the Company's emergency response, and organize the relevant personnel 
to provide support to the emergency response and to participate in the Company's emergency training and 
ship-shore joint drills. 
12. 个人技能的提升与发展 
关键流程： 不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报
个人发展需求（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术
水平。 
Promotion and development of personal skills 
Critical process: to keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the 
improvement of personal business skills and reporting the personal development requirements (i.e. training, 
communication and guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and constantly 
raising the level of business technology.

关键流程：保持与主管机关和外部有关单位的沟通与联系，维护良好的合作关系与交流

Professional training

替代关系 
Substitutability 
其他海务主管

具体职责 
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 海务安全的监督 
关键流程：监督船舶安全管理状况；进行登轮检查，审批船舶安全会报告，对发现的问
题予以指导并跟踪纠正；向部门经理、副经理报告工作情况。根据部门安排，现场协调
外审工作。 
Supervision of the ocean safety 
Critical process: to supervise the ship's safety management, to conduct onboard inspection, to examine and 
approve the ship safety report, to guide and follow up the problem corrections, and to report to the 
department manager and vice manager. To coordinate on-site external audit according to the department's 
arrangement. 
2. 船旗国检查和其他外部检查 
关键流程：给船上提供海务方面的相关信息和指导意见；监督船上做好自查并监督缺陷
纠正；及时通知相关部门提供岸基支持；监督所有缺陷在规定的期限内纠正。 
Conduct port state control and flag state inspection, and other external inspection 
Critical process: to provide relevant information and guidance to the ship, and to supervise the 
self-inspection and defect correction of the ship, timely informing the relevant departments to provide 
shore-based support and supervising the defect corrections within the prescribed time limit. 

44

3. 对船舶货物操作的监控 
关键流程： 审核船舶报备的配载图，重点监控装卸次序、隔票、是否超载、危险货物
的装载、重大件货物的积载情况等，向船舶提供必要的改进建议；审核船舶报备的装卸
货计划，重点对船舶稳性、整体和局部强度（剪力、弯矩、局部负荷等）进行复核，必
要时建议船舶进行调整。 
Monitor the ship's cargo operation 
Critical process: to review the reported ship loading chart, be focused on monitoring the stowage conditions 
such as the loading sequence, separation, overloading, dangerous cargo loading, heavy and large-sized 
cargo loading, etc., to provide necessary improvement suggestions to the ship, to review the reported cargo 
handling plan,be focused on reviewing the ship's stabilization, overall and local strength (such as shearing 
force, bending moment and local load, etc.), and recommend adjustment if necessary. 
4. 船舶航行安全的监控 
关键流程：监督、指导各轮航线的制定和安全航行，视情向船舶提出改正建议以使航线
达到安全、经济；视情为船舶安排气象导航并跟踪、监控；将船舶实际制定航次计划时
易出现的问题、驾驶员素质等情况及时报部门经理。  
Monitor the safety navigation of the ship 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the development of the navigation routes and safety, recommending 
improvement to the ship so as to make the route safe and economic, to arrange meteorological navigation 
for the ship and to conduct tracking and monitoring the ship as appropriated, and to report to the 
department manager the actual voyage plan problems and the ship steerer's quality in time. 
5. 搜集船舶海区气象并视情提供给相关船舶，指导船舶防范各种恶劣天气； 
关键流程： 收集海区气象资料，将气象资料发至受恶劣天气影响的船舶；指导船舶防
抗台风、避开海况恶劣海域；对航行在浪高5 米以上和风力8 级以上海区的船舶予以监
控并指导；填写船舶防抗台风（飓风）及大风浪情况记录表。 
To collect meteorological information from the marine area where the ship is navigating and provide them 
to the relevant ships, instructing the ships to prevent themselves from all kinds of severe weather. 
Critical process: to collect meteorological data and send them to the ships affected by the severe weather, to 
instruct the ships to prevent from typhoon and avoid bad sea conditions, to monitor and guide the ships 
sailing in the sea area where the height of the waves are more than 5 meters high and the wind strength is 
more than 8 registering level  on the Beaufort scale, and to fill out the ship's typhoon and storm prevention 
and resistance record. 
6. 船员培训 
关键流程：按照体系有关规定，实施船员的上船前培训和强化培训。 
Crew Training 
Critical process: to implement the crew's pre-boarding training and intensive training according to the 
relevant provisions of the system. 
7. 新接船舶 
关键流程： 
a.收集新接船舶装载仪软件等相关资料并妥善保存； 
b. 制作单船“SOLAS 训练手册”及时送船。 
New takeover ship 
Critical process: 
a. To collect the relevant software information of the new takeover ship's instrument and keep them 
properly; 
b. To develop single ship's "SOLAS training manual" and send it to the ship in time. 

45

8. 船舶能效管理 
关键流程：按照公司能效管理计划，负责海务方面船舶能效数据的搜集，获取船舶能效
管理数据分析和评价信息。 
Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan 
Critical process: to be responsible, according to the Company's Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan， 
for collecting the energy efficiency data in respect of marine affairs, and obtaining the data analysis and 
evaluation information of the ship's energy efficiency management. 
9. 船舶图书资料的管理 
关键流程：  
根据电子版航海通告的航海图书出版信息，及时整理列表，并转发各船舶； 
a. 负责有关航海资料的收集和评估； 
b. 负责航海图书(含电子海图)资料的审批、发放和控制； 
c. 拟定更换航海图书计划和审核船舶报来的航海图书申领计划，及时将审核后的计划 
通知供应部； 
d. 督促船舶每季度报送各轮海图、航海书籍、相关国际公约清单，建立各轮海图、航海
书籍、相关国际公约电子版清单，并根据该轮申请和供给随时补充完善，以保持最新
状态； 
e. 根据各船型需要配备海图、航海书籍的参考标准，列出清单通知新接船舶， 收到恢
复后通知采购部进行采购. 
Management of ship's books and information 
Critical process:  
To collate, based on the information of the published electronic notice to mariners, the lists and transmit 
them to each ship in time.  
a. To be responsible for the collection and evaluation of the navigation publication material. 
b. To be responsible for the review, delivery and control of nautical publications and materials (including 
electronic charts). 
c. To prepare the replacement of the navigation book plan and to review the application for nautical charts 
and publications, and inform the approved application to Purchasing Department in time. 
d. To urge each ship to submit the list of its nautical charts, navigation books and the relevant international 
convention quarterly, creating an electronic list accordingly, and update it simultaneously according to 
the ship’s application and supply so as to keep it updated. 
e. To prepare, according to the reference standard of each ship's nautical charts and navigation books, the 
list to notify the new ship, and inform, upon receiving the feedback, Purchasing Department to 
purchase. 
10. 管理本部门配置的海图和航海书籍 
关键流程： 
a.建立海图和航海书籍清单（纸文件）并存放在海监室海图清单文件夹内； 
b.建立电子版海图的海图清单和航海书籍清单。 
c.建立英版航海通告的电子版文件夹，并保持更新。 
Manage the nautical charts and navigation books of the department. 
Critical process: a. to create a list of the nautical charts and navigation books (paper files) and keep them in 
the chart folder of the Marine Surveillance Room. b. to create an electronic list of the nautical charts and 
navigation books. And c. to create an electronic English folder of the notices to mariners and keep it 
updated. 

46

03_23_3.chapter: 第七章 海务部组织机构及岗位说明书
03_23_3.text:

11. 预算编制 
关键流程：根据前一年度实际发生的海务费用情况，编制海务费用预算并报部门经理审
批。 
Budgeting 
Critical process: to prepare marine expense budget according to the actual marine expenses incurred in the 
previous year, and submit it to the department manager for approval. 
12. 了解、监控船舶动态 
关键流程： 及时向航运部、代理等了解船舶的最新动态并及时通报；监督各船舶动态
报告的及时性和规范性。发现动态报告异常的船舶及时报告海务部经理。 
Be informed of and monitor ship movement 
Critical process: timely to learn the latest information of the ship movement from Shipping Department 
and the agencies, and get them notified, and supervise the timeliness and normalization of the ship 
movement report. Timely inform the abnormality of the reported ship movement to the manager of Marine 
Department. 
13. 监控办公、通讯设备；文件的归档 
关键流程：监控部门的传真、打印机、复印机等办公设备的工作状况，发现问题及时处
理或报告；及时补充各种耗财；文件的分类及归档。 
Monitor the use of office installation and communication facility, and document filing 
Critical process: to monitor the working of the office installation such as fax machine, printer and 
photocopier, etc., timely handle or report their problems, and supplement consumables and responsible for 
document filing.

2. 编制和实施船舶保安计划

Critical process: to draft “Schedule of ISPS implementation” as the transitional arrangement for pre-initial

the Marine Department, to provide the internal security inspectors with the ship's security conditions, and 
to receive the internal audit report and follow up its defect correction, and to be responsible for keeping the 
internal audit files.

Critical process: to provide information about the ship security conditions and supervise the different defect 
correction.

Critical process: to collect information about ship security environment, to inform the ship of the security 
precautions, and to instruct the work of the ship security.

关键流程：船舶发生保安事件时及时报告，按照保安计划启动应急程序，参加应急反应；
处理保安事件发生后的调查、报告和善后工作。 
Handling of ship's security incidents 
Critical process: timely report the security incidents, and start the emergency procedures according to the 
security plan, to be engaged in the emergency response, and to be responsible for the investigation, report 
and afterward disposal.

关键流程：按海务部经理指示参加公司有关保安的应急反应，以及有关保安的船岸联合
演习。

Critical process: to participate in the Company's emergency response activities and the joint ship-shore 
security drills as instructed by the manager of Marine Department.

具体职责  
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 对公司船舶的安全和防污染负责，对PSC/FSC/RIGHT SHIP/P&I 等外部检查负责。协助
进行体系运行、人身安全和劳动保护、防偷渡、走私、毒品、麻醉品、酒精等工作。 
Responsible for the safety and pollution prevention of the Company's ships, and for external inspections 
such as PSC/FSC/RIGHT SHIP/P&I, etc. To assist in the system operation, personal safety and labour 
protection, and in preventing stowaway, smuggling, drugs, narcotics and alcohol, etc. 
2. 船舶维护 
关键流程：指导和监督部门副经理的日常管理工作；制定船舶年度修理计划和预算，审
核和批准船舶计划性修理和航修等临时性修理，并选择或指定修理厂。跟踪修理进度，
批准修理的延期或修理工程的变化。督促和跟踪船舶和设备缺陷的纠正。 
Ship maintenance 
Critical process: guide and supervise the daily management of the vice department manager, draw up the 
ship's annual repair plan and budget, audit and approve the ship's scheduled and temporary voyage repair 
and select or designate the shipyard.  Follow up the repair, approve the repair extension or the change of 
the repair projects.  Supervise and follow up the defect correction of the ship and equipment. 
3. SMIS 建立，使用和维护 
关键流程：监督SMIS 的建立、使用和维护情况。 
Creation, use and maintenance of SMIS 
Critical process: to supervise the creation, use and maintenance of SMIS. 
4. 作方案的制定 
关键流程：组织标明和制定与本部门主管业务有关的关键性船上操作方案。 
Establish ship operation scheme 
Critical process: to organize indicating and developing the ship’s key operation scheme related to the 
department. 
 
5. 不符合、事故和险情报告和处理 
关键流程：负责分派本部门有关的不符合、事故和险情的调查处理工作和纠正措施的实
施；负责内审及外审所提出的不符合的纠正和报告。 
Report and handle the Non-Conformity, accident and hazardous occurrences 
Critical process: responsible for the implementation of the investigation and corrective actions of the 
Non-Conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences related to the department, and responsible for 
correcting and reporting the Non-Conformities suggested in the internal and external audit. 
 
6. 部门内部业务学习及业务培训 
关键流程：按照本部门人员在培训方面的需求，每季度制定业务培训计划并组织实施；
本部门新聘和转岗员工的熟悉岗位培训；确定本部门员工的外部培训需求向行政部提出
申请。 
Internal vocational studies and training 
Critical process: to develop quarterly on-the-job training plan and organize its implementation according to 
the position requirements of the department, responsible for the training of new employees and the 
transferred employees, and responsible for determining the external training demand of the department and 
applying to Administration Department. 
 
 

59

7. 船员培训和审核 
关键流程： 组织本部门责任范围内的船员熟悉岗位培训；协调管理级船员的适任审核。 
Crew training and audit 
Critical process: to organize the on-the-job training of the crew in charge of the department's 
responsibilities to get a mastery of their job duties, and to coordinate the competency review of ship 
officers at the management level. 
8. 信息传递 
关键流程：指导和监督本部门职能范围内的管理信息的搜集、分析和处理。 
Information transfer 
Critical process: to guide and supervise the collection, analysis and processing of the management 
information within the function of the department. 
9. 应急准备 
关键流程：参加公司应急反应，并组织部门相关人员对应急反应提供支持。参加公司应
急训练和船岸联合演习。 
Preparation for emergency 
Critical process: engaged in the Company's emergency response, and organize the relevant personnel to 
provide support to the emergency response, and participate in the Company's emergency training and 
ship-shore joint drills. 
10. 文件管理 
关键流程：负责组织编写或修改所主管的程序和须知；组织编制并向船舶提供本部门有
关的船舶单项操作手册和记录簿；监督本部门文件管理情况；监督本部门主管业务范围
内的外来文件的符合性和组织发放；监督本部门主管业务范围内的外来文件的符合性和
发放；组织编制或更新本部门的记录清单并报送；批准作废文件的销毁。 
Document management 
Critical process: responsible for organizing or revising the supervised procedures and instructions, prepare 
and provide the ships with the relevant ship's single operation manual and record books of the department, 
supervise the document management of the department, supervise the conformity and distribution of the 
external documents within the business scope of the department, organize or update the record list of the 
department and submit them, and approve the destruction of the obsolete documents. 
11. 日常管理监督 
关键流程：监督和指导本部门各岗位的工作；审核和批示部门内的工作请示，向主管副
总经理报告部门所负责的工作状况；向主管部门报告不符合规定的情况。对港口国、船
旗国等检查情况进行监控和协调。 
Daily management and supervision 
Critical process: to supervise and guide the work of each position of the department, review and approve 
the work instructions of the department, report to the VGM in charge, and report the non-Conformities to 
the competent department. To monitor and coordinate the port state control and flag state inspection. 
12. 本部门工作定期自查 
关键流程：定期检查本部门工作记录和工作，采取必要的纠正措施，向主管部门报告不
符合规定的情况。对本部门安全管理体系运行实施监控并进行评估。 
Regular self-inspection of the department  
Critical process: to inspect the work record and the work of the department regularly, adopting necessary 
corrective actions and reporting the non-conformities to the competent department. To monitor and evaluate 
the safety management system of the department.

13. 数据分析 
关键流程：定期进行责任范围内的数据分析，并报告。 
Data analysis 
Critical process: to conduct regular data analysis on the responsibilities and report accordingly. 
14. 船舶交接 
关键流程：组织并监督实施船舶交接前的准备工作、交接的实施和接船后航行前的准备、
交船后登记注销等工作。 
Ship takeover and delivery 
Critical process: to organize and supervise the preparation for the ship’stake-over and delivery, and get 
prepared for the navigation after the ship’stake-over, and go through the de-registration after the 
ship’sdelivery. 
15. 费用计划 
关键流程：船舶维护和本部们设计的其他费用的年度计划，支出情况审核等。 
Cost planning  
Critical process: to audit annual cost planning of the ship maintenance and other expenses of the 
department. 
16. 对下属员工的管理及绩效考核 
关键流程：对所属员工的日常工作和关键业绩按规定进行考核，定期做出考核结果，并
实施培训。 
Management and performance appraisal of the subordinates 
Critical process: to conduct assessment and performance appraisal on the daily work of the subordinates 
according to the regulations, implementing training regularly based on the assessment results. 
17. 个人技能的提升与发展 
关键流程： 不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报
个人发展需求（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术
水平。 
Promotion and development of personal skills 
Critical process: to keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the 
improvement of personal business skills and reporting the personal development requirements (i.e. training, 
communication and guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and constantly 
raising the level of business technology. 
18. 对外交流 
关键流程：保持与各部门以及外部有关单位的沟通与联系，维护良好的合作关系与交流
渠道，了解业务信息和管理活动的反馈情况，及时汇总上报主管领导。 
External exchange 
Critical process: to keep in communication and touch with all departments and external relevant units to 
maintain good cooperative and exchange relationship, be informed of the business information and 
feed-back of management activities, and timely sum them up and report to the competent leadership. 
19. 完成领导交办的其他临时性任务 
To complete other temporary tasks assigned by the leadership.

Ship Maintenance and Management 
Critical process:  Instruct and supervise the daily management of the superintendent, review the onboard 
inspection report under the leadership of the department manager.  Supervise the superintendent to audit 
SMIS.  Review and approve the revision of SMIS plan. 
2. 安排船舶厂修、指导机务总管有关维修工作

shipyard repairing in respect of determining such important matters as repair time and key content, 
testing and auditing the important technical data, and developing the repair process, etc., timely 
requesting the manager of the department to purchase and replace the major repair items and valuable 
spare part during the repairing, giving accurate reply to the on-site superintendent, and urging the 
superintendent to verify the repair effect at the end of the repair.

汇报。

report audit and the repair arrangement, the confirmation of the major ship store and spare parts, the 
formulation of the maintenance plan and the onboard inspection. To check the superintendent's 
management on the ship certificates and inspection reports, etc. And to evaluate the above of the 
superintendent's and report to the department manager timely.

4. 港口国检查控制 
关键流程：汇总船旗国、船级社及各备忘录地区港口国检查的信息，对港口国检查中
出现的问题进行分析、归类，查找缺陷造成的原因和发展趋势，制定预防和持续性改
进措施，指导船舶和机务总管做好港口国检查的准备工作。监控港口国检查的结果，
及时向部门经理汇报；负责定期向船旗国递交本公司船舶接受港口国检查数据报告。 
Port state control and flag state inspection. 
Critical process: to sum up the information of port state control and flag state inspection, classification 
society surveys and the port state inspections in each memo area, analyzing and classifying the problems 
arising from the inspection, and finding out the defect reasons and growing trend, developing the 
prevention and successive improvement measures, and instructing the ship and the superintendent to get 
prepared for the port state inspection. To monitor the results of port state control and flag state inspection. 
and report to the department manager timely, and responsible for submitting the flag state with the 
regular data reports of the inspection on the Company's ships. 
5. 日常管理工作 
关键流程：协助部门经理工作，并作为部门经理的替代人。在部门经理的领导下，制
定工作计划，部署本部门的日常管理工作，做好本部门各岗位人员培训。 
Daily management 
Critical process: to assist the department manager and act as his/her replacement and develop the 
department's work planning, deploying the daily management and conducting the staff training under the 
leadership of the department manager. 
6. 个人技能的提升与发展 
关键流程：不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报
个人发展需求（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术
水平。 
Promotion and development of personal skills 
Critical process: to keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the 
improvement of personal business skills and reporting the personal development requirements (i.e. 
training, communication and guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and 
constantly raising the level of business technology. 
7. 对外交流 
关键流程：保持与各部门、下属公司以及外部有关单位的沟通与联系，维护良好的合
作关系与交流渠道， 了解业务信息和管理活动的反馈情况，及时汇总上报主管领导。 
External exchange 
Critical process: to keep in communication and touch with all departments, subsidiaries and external 
relevant units to maintain good cooperative and exchange relationship, be informed of the business 
information and feed-back of management activities, and timely sum them up and report to the competent 
leadership. 
8. 完成领导交办的其他临时性任务 
To complete other temporary tasks assigned by the leadership.

具有船舶检验和管理技能以及良好的英语听说读写能力 
Have abundant knowledge in machinery and ship structure, equipment maintenance, as

Capable of enterprise management skill and English listening, speaking, reading and

management, implementing unswervingly the Company's management policy, always 
take the benefit of the Company as priority .

Responsibilities in Details 
1. 所管船舶维护保养工作计划 
关键流程： 建立并不断完善主管船舶SMIS 系统，审核和批复船舶维护工作记录。监督
和指导船舶的维护工作，包括货运任务所要求的特殊设备、设施和器材的检验和维护。 
Maintenance plan of the ship 
Critical process: to establish and keep improving the ship's SMIS system, reviewing and approving the ship 
maintenance records. To supervise and instruct the ship maintenance, including the inspection and 
maintenance of special equipment and facility for the freight task.

2. 滑油使用监控管理 
关键流程：关注滑油化验报告，认真研究化验分析结果，根据分析结果指导船舶采取有
效措施，并监控船舶的实施情况，直到正常 
Monitoring and managing lubricating oil using 
Critical process: to give attention to the lubricating oil test report, carefully studying its analytic results, to 
guide the ship to take effective measures according to the analysis, and monitor its using on the ship until it 
is normal. 
3. 船舶证书和检验 
关键流程：在SMIS 中检查船舶相关证书、报告的有效性；督促船长及时更新SMIS《船
舶证书》中的相关内容。负责保管船舶证书、报告的副本。对PSC 检查过程进行监控，
对检查报告进行收集、存档。 
Ship certificate and survey 
Critical process: to confirm the validity of the ship's relevant certificates and reports in SMIS, to urge the 
master to update the relevant contents of the "SMIS certificate" in time. To be responsible for keeping 
copies of the ship certificates and reports. To monitor the PSC survey process, collecting and filing the 
survey reports. 
4. 负责主管船舶厂修，航修及事故性修理的质量和进度控制 
关键流程： 审核船舶的修理申请单报告主管副经理批准、报价、现场监修或通过船员
监修，现场处理或请示部门副经理后处理修理过程中的疑难问题。审核修船结算单并负
责修理费用的结算。 
Responsible for the quality and progress control of the shipyard repair, voyage repair and accident repair of 
the ship in charge. 
Critical process: review the application and the quotation of the ship repair and report to the vice GM in 
charge, to supervise the on-site repair or via-the-crew repair, to handle the on-site or request the vice 
department manager to handle the difficult problems during the repair process. To audit the ship repair 
statement and responsible for the repair cost settlement. 
5. 缺陷报告的处理 
关键流程： 审核船舶的缺陷报告，提供物资或技术支持。或向部门副经理做出请示。 
Process the reports about the defects 
Critical process: to review the reports about the ship's defects, providing material or technical supports, or 
requesting the vice department manager. 
6. 登轮检查 
关键流程：对所管理的船舶进行安全检查。检查的内容涉及船舶和设备的维护保养，备
件物料的管理和使用，船舶状况、设备操作及安全作业，防污染工作等。写出登轮检查
报告.涉及到船舶安全的缺陷内容，通报部门经理。负责船舶操作方案的制定。 
Onboard inspection 
Critical process: to perform the inspections on the ships in 
charge. To inspect the maintenance of the ships and their equipment, the management and use of the ship 
store and spare parts, the ships' conditions, the equipment operation, the safety operation and pollution 
prevention, etc. To write the report of the onboard inspection, including the ship's defects and safety, and 
notify the department manager. To be responsible for establishing the ship operation scheme.

organizing the crew training in technical management, ship structure and daily maintenance, etc. To be 
responsible for reviewing the qualification of the Chief Engineer and the engineers. To draft the crew 
training outlines and get familiar with the post materials, assisting the crew in strengthening training. 
8. 港口国检查和其他外部检查 
关键流程：掌握船舶实际情况，及时给船上提供相关信息和指导意见；监督船上做好自
查并监督缺陷纠正；为船舶提供岸基支持；船舶接受检查期间实时跟踪检查过程；做好

缺陷在规定的期限内纠正。 
Conduct port state control and flag state inspection and other external inspections. 
Critical process: to master the actual conditions of the ship, timely providing relevant information and 
instructions to the ship; to supervise the ship's self-inspection and supervise the defect correction; to 
provide shore-based support to the ship; to conduct real-time tracking  inspection; to complete external 
coordination and communication with the related parties; to assist the ship's external inspection and inform 
the relevant departments to take measures; and to supervise all defects corrected within the prescribed time 
limit. 
9. 个人技能的提升与发展 
关键流程：不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报个
人发展需求（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术水平。
Promotion and development of personal skills 
Critical process: to keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the 
improvement of personal business skills and reporting the personal development requirements (i.e. training, 
communication and guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and constantly 
raising the level of business technology. 
10. 对外交流 
关键流程：保持与各部门、下属公司以及外部有关单位的沟通与联系，维护良好的合作
关系与交流渠道， 了解业务信息和管理活动的反馈情况，及时汇总上报主管领导。 
External exchange 
Critical process: to keep in communication and touch with all departments, subsidiaries and external 
relevant units to maintain good cooperative and exchange relationship, be informed of the business 
information and feed-back of management activities, and timely sum them up and report to the competent 
leadership. 
11. 船舶能效管理 
按照公司能效管理计划，负责船舶能效数据的搜集，获取船舶能效管理数据和评价信息。
提供船舶能效管理所涉及的设备技术以及燃油管理职责范围内的相关支持。 
Ship Energy Efficiency Management 
Critical process: to be responsible, according to the Company's Ship Energy Efficiency Management Plan, 
for collecting the energy efficiency data and obtaining the data analysis and evaluation information of the 
ship's energy efficiency management. And to provide the energy efficiency management related equipment 
technology and the fuel management responsibility related support.

1. 船舶电气设备的管理工作 
关键流程： 
在部门经理的领导下，执行公司的质量安全方针，协助机务主管做好船舶电气设备的管理工作； 
协助机务主管对船舶电气设备的维修保养、定期测试情况进行检查。对设备主管人员进行指导； 
The management of marine electrical equipment. 
Critical process: 
Under the leadership of the department manager, implement the company's quality and safety policy, 
assist technical superintendent to make the management of marine electrical equipment.  Assist technical 
superintendent to inspect the maintenance of electrical equipment, regularly tests. Guide the equipment 
superintendent.  
2. 主管船舶电气设备修理的质量和进度控制 
关键流程： 参与船舶电气设备出现紧急情况的处理工作。船舶电气设备故障需外协修
理或更换的，尽可能多家报价。根据设备状况，决定修理范围或更换何种设备；工程
较大的，报部门经理批准实施。 监督外协修理的船舶电气设备的修理质量，负责审核
修理帐单，无误后交机务主管确认。 
Responsible for the quality and progress control of the repair of ship electrical equipment in charge. 
Critical process:  
Participate in the dispose while the ship electrical equipment occurred emergency. 
Get as many quotations as possible for the failure of ship electrical equipment to be repaired or replaced 
by external contractors. According to equipment status, decide what kind of repair or replacement of the 
range equipment; major works shall report to the manager of the departments for approval.  
Monitor the outsourcing repair electrical equipment quality, audit the repair bill, submit it to technical 
superintendent for affirm after correction. 
3. 缺陷报告的处理 
关键流程： 审核船舶的电气设备的缺陷报告，提供物资或技术支持，或向部门副经理
做出请示。协助机务主管监督船舶对电气设备的不符合项的纠正、验证。 
Process the reports about the defects 
Critical process: To review the reports about the ship's electrical equipment defects, providing material or 
technical supports, or requesting the vice department manager. Assist technical superintendent to supervise 
the non-conformities term corrective /verification of ship electrical equipment. 
4. 登轮检查 
关键流程：定期对回国的船舶进行登轮检查，了解船上电气设备的状况以及操作人员的
情况，收集有关资料，现场解决有关设备人员的问题，协调、监督电气工程人员的工作。
及时、认真地指导和考核船舶电气主管人员的电气业务，及时指导船舶进行电气设备的
检查维护，按规定期限检查船舶电气设备的维护情况。 
Onboard inspection 
Critical process: to carry out regular onboard inspection on the returning ship, learning about the onboard 
electrical equipment and the operators’ conditions, collecting the relevant data, solving the on-site problems 
concerned with the relevant equipment and personnel, coordinating and supervising the electronic 
engineers. To guide and evaluate the ship steerer on the electrical business timely and carefully, to instruct 
the ship to carry out the electrical equipment inspection and maintenance in time, and to check the 
maintenance of the equipment according to the prescribed time.

培训，向负责船舶电气设备的船员提供必要的专业培训；协助船员强化培训。

参与审核船舶电气设备的操作方案；  
Assist the crew training, examination and internal training in the department. 
Critical process: to follow the department manager's deployment to assist in organizing the crew training in 
technical management and daily maintenance. Provide the necessary professional training for the crew in 
charge of ship electrical equipment, assisting the crew in strengthening training. And participate in the 
assessment and training of the seafarers in charge of the ship's electrical equipment and hold veto power 
over their appointment. Participate in audit the operation scheme of ship electrical equipment. 
6. 技术信息管理 
关键流程：搜集国内外有关船舶电气设备的相关信息，提供信息交流。 
The management of technical information  
Collect domestic and foreign related electrical equipment information of ship, and provide information 
communication. 
7. 个人技能的提升与发展 
关键流程： 不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报
个人发展需求（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术
水平。Promotion and development of personal skills 
Critical process: to keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the 
improvement of personal business skills and reporting the personal development requirements (i.e. training, 
communication and guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and constantly 
raising the level of business technology. 
8. 对外交流 
关键流程：保持与各部门、下属公司以及外部有关单位的沟通与联系，维护良好的合作
关系与交流渠道，了解业务信息和管理活动的反馈情况，及时汇总上报主管领导；监督
外协修理的船舶电气设备的修理质量，负责审核修理帐单，无误后交机务主管确认。 
External exchange 
Critical process: to keep in communication and touch with all departments, subsidiaries and external 
relevant units to maintain good cooperative and exchange relationship, be informed of the business 
information and feed-back of management activities, and timely sum them up and report to the competent 
leadership. Monitor the outsourcing repair electrical equipment quality, audit the repair bill, submit it to 
technical superintendent for affirm after correction. 
9. 完成领导交办的其他临时性任务 
To complete other temporary tasks assigned by the leadership.

具体职责 
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 按照相关的国际、国内强制性公约和规则以及IMO、主管机关、船级社、行业组织所
建议的适用的规则、指南和标准，开展船舶通导业务管理工作；负责收集国际、国内
关于船舶通导方面的公约、规则和规定以及相关信息，制定公司船舶通导管理规定；
负责监督、指导船舶执行国际、国内有关海上无线电通信规程。 
To conduct the management of the ship communication and navigation in accordance with the relevant 
international and domestic mandatory conventions and regulations, and the applicable rules, guidelines and 
standards recommended by IMO, competent authorities, classification societies and industrial 
organizations; to be responsible for collecting international and domestic conventions, regulations and 
provisions on ship communication and navigation and the relevant information, and to develop the 
Company's management regulations on ship communication and navigation, responsible for supervising 
and guiding the ships to implement the international and domestic regulations on maritime radio 
communication. 
2. 保证船用通导设备的正常 
关键流程：根据船上反应的通导设备的故障现象，提供必要的技术指导，尽量自己解决，
确实需要岸基支持时安排国内外电子工程师登轮检查、修理。 保证通信的畅通。 
Ensure the normal operation of the marine communication and navigation equipment 
Critical process: to provide necessary technical guidance to process the malfunction of the marine 
communication and navigation equipment and try to solve the problems as far as possible, and to arrange 
domestic or foreign electronic engineers to get on broad to perform checking and repairing when the 
shore-based support is required, ensuring smooth communication. 
3. 安排无线电检验及VDR(S-VDR) 
关键流程：各轮每年都要进行无线电检验、VDR（S-VDR）、EPIRB 的检验，需要沟通
各船级社，然后安排符合船级社要求的电子公司登轮检验。  
Arrange radio inspection and VDR(S-VDR) 
Critical process: to conduct annual radio inspection, VDR(S-VDR) and EPIRB test on each ship, to contact 
with classification societies at different levels before arranging the electronic company that meets the 
requirements of the classification societies to carry out onboard inspection. 
4. 保证通导证书、应急设备的有效 
关键流程：检查船舶通导设备证书和应急设备是否在有效范围之内，如果接近检验日期，
提前安排检验或供应物料；以确保上述设备在有效的范围之内。 
Ensure the effectiveness of the communication and navigation certificates and the emergency equipment. 
Critical process: to check and ensure the certificates and the equipment within the effective range, and to 
arrange the inspection or to supply the ship store and spare parts in advance upon the upcoming inspection 
so as to ensure their effective operation.

Training 
Critical process: to assist the Crew Department to conduct the training of the communication and

方针，以公司利益为重。 
Capability/knowledge requirements: capable of communication and verbal skills, 
familiar with the computer operation, and fluent in English listening, speaking, 
reading and writing. 
Personality requirements: having strong sense of responsibility, dedication and team 
spirit; consciously and highly consistent with the Company in daily work and 
management, implementing unswervingly the Company's management policy, 
always take the benefit of the company as priority. 
权限 
Rights 
对本岗位的管理工作有建议权。 
The right to propose the management suggestions to the position. 
替代关系 
Substitutability 
由机务总管替代或者主管船管部副总指定。 
Substitutable by the superintendent or designated by the VGM in charge of feet 
departments 
具体职责  
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 文件管理 
负责本模块体系文件和资料的管理；负责外来文件（包括：新公约、法规、通函等信息）
的翻译、发放和本部门存档；定期收集船旗国、船级社及各港口国备忘录地区有关港口
国检查的信息，及时通报船管副总及船管部；及时更新船舶通讯录。 
Document management 
To be responsible for the management of documents and materials in the module system, responsible for 
translating, distributing and filing the external documents (including: new conventions, rules and 
regulations, letters and telegrams, etc.); regularly collect the information of port state control and flag state 
inspection, classification society survey and the relevant port state inspections in memorandum area, timely 
reporting to the VGM in charge of the fleet departments, and timely updating the ship's address book. 
2. 船舶注册 
关键流程：根据船舶注册的要求，收集并提供相关的技术资料，跟踪船舶注册的情况。 
Ship registration 
Critical process: collect and provide, according to requirements of ship registration, the relevant technical 
data, tracking ship registration.

3. 船、岸端SMIS 软件常见问题的解决及数据库的日常维护 
关键流程：对维保软件运行中出现的问题进行分析、解决，必要时向开发单位寻求技术
支持；进行船岸数据同步操作，监控来往数据的传输，保证各船与岸端正常进行数据交
换；对SMIS 数据库进行日常维护和定期备份，保证数据库正常、可靠地运行，尽可能
减少各种突发性事件造成的数据损失。 
Solve the common problems of ship and shore SMIS software and conduct routine maintenance on the 
database. 
Critical process: analyze and solve the problems that occur in the operation of the maintained software, 
seeking technical support from the development institution if necessary. Conduct the synchronization 
operation on the ship and shore data, monitoring data transmission to ensure the normal data exchange 
between the ships and shore. Conduct routine maintenance and regular backup of SMIS database to ensure 
the normal and reliable operation of the database, minimizing the data loss caused by unexpected events. 
4. 沟通协调 
及时向本模块通报相关公约、通函的要求；做好本模块各种培训和例会的记录、并且保
存；及时向船舶发送船级社的检验信息；根据安排，发送对船通电或文件；及时向本模
块传达领导交代的其他信息。 
Communication and coordination 
Timely notify the module of the requirements of the relevant conventions, letters and telegrams, completing 
the module's training and recording the regular meeting and keeping it properly, and timely transmit the 
survey information of classification society to the ship, and transmit telegrams or documents to the ship as 
arranged, timely passing on the leadership's instructions and other information to the module. 
5. 证书管理 
协助机务总管做好证书、报告的管理工作，将各船的证书副本整理更新归档，及时扫描、
更新和存档相关证书电子版，提醒机务总管注意相关证书的有效性。 
Certificate management 
Assist the superintendent in the management of certificates and reports, sorting out, updating and filing the 
copies of each ship's certificate, timely scanning, updating and archiving the digital versions of the related 
certificates and reminding the superintendent of giving attention to the effectiveness of the relevant 
certificates. 
6. 资料室管理 
各船舶技术资料更新，保持资料室整洁。 
Reference room management 
Update each ship's technical information and keep the room tidy. 
7. 综合管理 
参与船管部预算的编制、统计与预算执行、监控；负责预算表格的生成、编辑、更新和
上报；负责船管部年度培训计划的编制、执行与记录。 
Integrated management 
Participate in the budget preparation, statistics, implementation and monitoring of fleet departments, 
responsible for creating, compiling, updating and reporting the budget form, and for the preparation, 
implementation and recording of the annual training plan of the fleet departments. 
8. 个人技能的提升与发展 
不断地学习业务知识，随时与主管领导交流个人业务技能提高情况，汇报个人发展需求
（培训、交流和指导等），获得指导帮助，改进不足，不断提高业务技术水平。 
Promotion and development of personal skills 
To keep learning business knowledge, communicating with the executive about the improvement of 
personal business skills and report the personal development requirements (i.e. training, exchange and 
guidance, etc.) so as to get instruction and help, improving insufficiency and constantly raising the level of 
business technology.

具体职责 
Responsibilities in Details 
1. 负责人身安全和劳动保护工作。对防偷渡、走私、毒品、麻醉品、酒精事项负责，并协
助体系运行、PSC/FSC/RIGHT SHIP/P&I 等外部检查工作。 
Responsible for personal safety and labour protection. Responsible for the prevention of stowaway, 
smuggling, drugs, narcotics and alcohol, etc., and assist the system operation and the external inspections 
such as PSC/FSC/RIGHT SHIP/P&I, etc. 
2. 组织制定和完善船员招聘、调配、培训、工资、晋升、奖惩制度 
关键流程：根据公司的发展战略和经营目标，在总经理指导下，组织公司船员各项管理
制度的制定，督导实施；依据制度的执行状况，提出修改优化管理制度的建议，经公司
核准后实施。组织对外派船员公司的考核评审工作。组织船员招聘，根据船员数量变化
情况分析原因，向公司领导层提出改进建议。 
Develop and improve the relevant systems in respect of crew recruitment, deployment and 
training, salary, promotion, and reward and punishment. 
Critical process: develop and formulate, according to the Company's development strategy and 
business objectives, the management system of the Company crew and supervise the 
implementation under the guidance of the GM in charge; and put forward, according to the 
implementation, suggestions to revise and optimize the management system, and put it into 
operation after approval. Organize the accreditation test of sailor dispatching company. Organize 
the crew recruitment, analyzing the change of the crew quantity and putting forward improvement 
suggestions to the Company's leadership. 
3. 负责各职船员的调配工作，为船舶配备合格、适任、健康的船员 
关键流程：根据公司船队的发展计划及船员资源储备情况，负责船队发展需要的船员配
备计划的制定，并组织实施。 
Responsible for the deployment of the crew members of each post, manning the ships with 
qualified and healthy crew members. 
Critical processes: responsible, according to the development plan of the Company's fleet and the crew 
resources, for formulating and implementing the manning plan for the crew members for the fleet 
development. 
4. 审核船员换班计划 
关键流程：根据公司船队的发展计划及船员资源储备情况，制定接船计划、船员配备、
晋升计划，经主管领导批准后组织实施。 
Review the crew deployment plan 
Critical process: assist the department manage, according to the development plan of the Company's fleet 
development and the crew resources, in making the plan for ship hand-over, crew deployment and 
promotion, organizing the implementation after approval by the leadership in charge.

5. 负责在船船员的管理，船员考核工作结果的处理 
关键流程：负责在船船员的管理，保证船舶有序营运。依据船员考核办法并根据考核结
果，负责船员的思想教育和处理。根据考核情况负责船员提升、降职、处分、奖励等工
作。 
Responsible for the management of on-boarding crew, processing the crew assessment. 
Critical processes: responsible for the management of on-boarding crew, ensuring the ship operating in 
order. Report, according to the crew assessment method and result, responsible for the crew's thought 
education and processing. Responsible for the promotion and demotion, and punishment and rewarding of 
the crew according to the assessment. 
6. 与业务部门的沟通、与船舶领导的沟通 
关键流程：同公司业务部门定期沟通，将船员调配计划提前通知有关业务部门。与船长、
轮机长定期沟通，掌握船员基本情况。 
Communicate with business departments and ship's leadership. 
Critical process: communicate regularly with the business departments and inform the relevant business 
department of the crew deployment plan in advance. Regularly communicate with the ship master and chief 
engineer so as to get a mastery of the crew's basic information. 
 
7.负责船员劳动保护工作，对船员伤亡进行调查处理，处理船员投诉。 
关键流程：加强船员安全意识的培养，根据指定人员的指示，对船员伤亡进行调查处理。
处理船员投诉，并向主管副总报告 。 
Responsible for the crew's labor protection, investigating and handling the crew casualties, and crew 
complaints.  
Critical process: enhance the safety awareness training of the crew, investigating and handling the crew 
casualties according to the DP's instructions. Handle the crew complaints and report to the VGM in charge. 
8.船员培训的监督协调 
关键流程：协调各业务部门跟踪实施船员培训工作；明确在船培训职责，不断完善船员
培训工作。并向主管副总经理提出对船员业务技能、综合知识和素质提出培训建议。负
责船员整体培训目标的实现工作。 
Supervision and coordination of the crew training 
Critical process: coordinate with each business department to follow up the crew training, clarifying the 
responsibilities of on-board training and keeping improving the training. Suggest to VGM in charge the 
training of the crew on professional skill, comprehensive knowledge and quality. Responsible for the 
overall training of the crew. 
9.负责船员应急情况的处理 
关键流程：负责船员在船应急情况的处理，尽可能迅速有效的处理好船员的突发事件，
使之得到切实有效及合理安排。按照应急计划的要求参加应急反应。 
Responsible for handling the crew's emergency 
Critical process: responsible for handling the on boarding crew's emergency, rapidly and effectively as 
much as possible handling the emergencies of the crew, so as to make it effectively and reasonably 
arranged. Participate in the emergency response activities as required by the emergency plan.

关键流程：对管理体系提出有效性评价意见和建议，制定相应的纠正措施并组织实施。

selection and application of statistical techniques in the department.

Communicate with the crew dispatching organizations and the shipowners 
Critical process: evaluate the crew partner. Establish a good business relationship with the crew dispatching 
organizations, creating an excellent environment for the Company's business. 
16.不符合规定的情况的报告和处理 
关键流程：负责本部门发现的不符合规定的情况的调查、分析和预防措施方案的制定；
负责本部门纠正和预防措施的实施。 
Report and handle non-conformities. 
Critical process: responsible for the investigation and analysis of the non-conformities in the department, 
and develop the preventing and correcting measures, and responsible for their implementation.

to the Company's relevant departments.

External audit of the ship (including security's external audit) 
Critical process: to develop the annual external audit plan, to arrange and coordinate, according to the 
plan and the leadership instructions, the audit of each ship, notifying each ship to arrange external audit, 
to send audit application to the audit institution, to follow up the non-conformity corrections and submit 
the corrective evidence to the audit institution, and keep the documents such as certificate and audit

Company's relevant departments, ships and relevant external circles.

and the ships, to register, follow up and verify the closure of the non-conformities, and responsible for

03_28.chapter: 第十二章 岗位交接制度
03_28.text:
第十二章 岗位交接制度 
Chapter 12  Post Shift Regulation 
 
1 
目的和范围 
Purpose and scope  
1.1 岗位交接制度是公司工作制度的一项重要内容，严格执行岗位交接制度有利于保障工
作的连续性，有利于明确职责，保证员工按照规定顺利交接工作。 
Post shift regulation is an important part of the company's working regulations. Strict implementation of 
the Post Shift Regulation is beneficial to guarantee the continuity of work, make clear the responsibilities, 
and ensure the employees shift the work in accordance with the provisions. 
1.2 本制度使用于岸基所有岗位 
This regulation is applicable to all positions on shore. 
2 
具体规定 
Specific regulations 
2.1 员工办理离职手续、员工工作岗位调整等情况下，必须严格履行岗位交接制度，将所
负责的工作移交给接班人员。船舶岗位交接按照船员交接制度执行。 
Employee demission and position change must strictly fulfill the post shift regulations, the work will be 
handed over to the successor. The shipboard post shift should follow the crew post shift regulation. 
2.2 部门经理负责岗位交接安排，确认交班人、接班人、监交人和交接时间。交接时间一
般不超过三天。在规定的交接时间内，如接班者未到，交班者不得离岗。因擅自离岗
而发生的一切问题由交班人负责。交班人擅自离岗、接班人不按时间接班等情况，属
于违反公司劳动纪律行为。交、接班人员因故将不能按时参加的交接的，要提前向部
门经理书面报告。 
The Department Manager is responsible for post shift arrangements, confirming the handing-over shift, 
the taking-over shift, the supervisor, and the shift time. The shift time shall take no more than three days. 
In the scheduled shift time, the handing over shift can not leave the post prior to the arrival of the taking 
over shift. Any problem caused by unauthorized leave shall be responsible by the handing-over shift. 
Unauthorized leave and not able to shift in time are violating the company's labor discipline. If the 
handing-over shift and the taking-over shift can not shift the post for certain reasons, please report to the 
department manager in writing in advance. 
2.3 岗位交接必须有专人负责监交。部门员工的交接工作由部门经理负责监交；部门经理
的工作交接，由主管领导负责监交；公司领导层岗位的工作交接由公司总经理办公会
指派人员监交。岗位工作交接内容的具体要求由监交人提出，监交人要负责移交工作
的全面性和有效性，妥善处理交接过程中的争议问题。 
The post shift shall be supervised by designated person. The post shift of department members shall be 
supervised by the department manager; the post shift of department managers shall be supervised by 
leader in charger; the leadership position shift shall be supervised by the personal appointed by the 
General Manager office. The specific post shift requirements shall be put forward by the supervisor, and 
the supervisor is responsible for the comprehensiveness and validity of the shift work and properly handle 
the dispute in the process of shift. 
2.4 交班人必须提前作好移交准备工作，负责提供“交接报告”（见附录1）。交班人要
提前办结有关工作，整理所负责资料文件档案，检查清点交接物品。对于未办结工作，
要有妥善的安排计划。交接前出现的物品损坏、丢失、资料缺失等情况，均由交班人
负责。“交接报告”要求字迹清晰、条理分明、内容齐全，需要详细陈述事宜或物品
清单等可另附加说明，进一步明确移交内容。 
The handing-over shift must be well prepared for the shift in advance and provide the "Shift Report" (see 
Appendix 1). The handing-over shift shall complete the work in advance, sort out the documents, check 

管理须知手册                      版次/修改：3.0/4.0                          INS-12 
Shorebase Instruction Manual          Version/Revise: 3.0/4.0                       INS-12 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15         第2/2页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 2/2 
the inventory items and make arrangement to the incomplete work.  The handing-over shift is 
responsible for any items or data damaged or lost before the shift. "Shift Report" requires clear writing, 
clear structure, and complete content. If detailed explanation is needed, please attach additional 
information such as the description of the matter or item list for further clarification. 
2.5 交接过程要求做到“五清三交接”。“五清”即：看清、讲清、问清、查清、点清。
“三交接”指现场交接、实物交接、操作交接。交接工作要现场当面交接，严禁电话
交接工作。特殊情况下不能现场交接的，经主管领导批准后，由部门经理代为交接。
接班人要按照“交接报告”内容逐项核对验收交接设备、物品及资料。对于重要工作
程序和业务内容，应通过实践操作完成交接。对于未办结工作和待办事项应必须书面
记录在“交接报告”中。交班人所交事项不清的，接班人有权拒绝接班，并应及时向
监交人报告情况。会计出纳等特殊岗位的工作交接，应遵守相关管理规定，妥善处理
好现金、支票、证券、印鉴、账本等。 
The shift process requires “Five Clears and Three Shifts”. Five-Clears means see clearly, express clearly, 
ask clearly, check clearly, and count clearly. “Three Shifts” refer to the site shift, physical object shift and 
operation shift. Post shift shall be done face to face at the site. Shift handover by phone call is strictly 
prohibited. If the post can not be shifted at site due to special reasons, after approved by the leader in 
charge, the department manager will help to shift the post on behalf of the shifting employee. The taking 
over shift shall check and accept the equipment, articles and documents in accordance with the “Shift 
Report” item by item. The shift of important work procedures and business should be completed through 
the operation practically. On-going work and to-do matters must be recorded in the Shift Report in writing. 
If the issues shifted by handing over shift is not clear, the taking over shift has the right to refuse the take 
over, and should promptly report to the supervisor. The post shift in special positions should comply with 
the relevant management regulations, for example the shift of accounting treasurer shall properly handle 
cash, checks, securities, seals, books and so on. 
2.6 交接完毕后，交班人、接班人和监交人在“交接报告”上签字确认。岗位交接工作的
完成以监交人在“交接报告”上签字为准。交班人和接班人应对交接内容的完整性、
合法性、真实性承担法律责任，公司保留追究相关法律责任的权利。 
After the completion of shift, the handing over shift, the taking over shift and the supervisor shall sign on 
the Shift Report for confirmation. The completion of the post shift is subject to the signature of the 
supervisor on the Shift Report. The handing over shift and the taking over shift shall bear the legal 
responsibility for the integrity, legality and authenticity of the shift work, and the company reserves the 
right to pursue the relevant legal liability. 
2.7 “交接报告”由部门经理保存。 
The Shift Report is kept by the department manager. 
2.8 员工出差或因请假短期离开工作岗位的，由替代人负责其工作。预期超过一个月的应
安排专人接替其工作，由各部门经理安排岗位工作交接。交接报告各部门自行保存。
根据工作需要，各岗位调整具体工作内容的，可采取工作记录的形式，或根据部门经
理决定以“交接报告”记录工作交接情况。 
The post of the employee, who is going on business or holiday for a short period of time, shall be 
responsible by his substitute. If the leave of absence lasts more than one month, the department manager 
should arrange a shift of work and appoint a staff to handle his or her responsibilities. The Shift Report is 
kept by the related department. If necessary, specific working content can be adjusted for each position in 
the form of working records, or to prepare a “Work shift report” recording the details according to the 
decision made by department manager.

03_29.chapter: 第十三章 船舶报账制度
03_29.text:
第十三章 船舶报账制度 
Chapter 13 Ship Reimbursement Regulation 
 
1.0 船舶报账单据的填制要求 
Requirements for filling reimbursement document 
 
1.1 伙食费明细表  
Food expenses list  
要求填写船名、起止日期、实际在船人数、总计天数、标准、应报伙食费等。 
The ship name, starting and ending date, number of crews, total days, the norm, as well as food expenses 
shall be filled in the list. 
1.2 扫舱、洗舱费、劳务费 
Hold sweeping and washing charges, service charges. 
填写船名、航次、起止日期、劳务发生港、货物名称、金额等,并附批复的邮件。 
Fill in the ship name, voyage, starting and ending date, the port of service, the name of the goods, and the 
amount, and attach the approved email as well. 
1.3 船舶招待费的使用 
Entertainment expenses 
不得在伙食费领报表中列支或用自制“便条”顶替。国外港口如遇特殊情况需支付个
人现金（如验舱费）必须经公司相关部门同意并填写招待费使用申请单。 
Entertainment expenses shall not be included in the food expenses or replaced by self-made "note". In 
case of special circumstances, cash (such as the hold inspection fee) paid personally at overseas port must 
be approved by the relevant departments of the company and fill in the application form. 
1.4 原则上只有在港口发生的交通费用在船上报销，船员上下船差旅费原则上回公司报销，
特殊情况下需要在船报销的，须经船员部批准。报销单后要附原始车票，并由左至右
顺序粘贴。 
 
In principle, only the traffic charges incurred at the port are allowed to be reimbursed on board. The 
travel expenses of the crew shall be reimbursed in company. In special circumstances, the travel expenses 
are allowed be reimbursed on board with the approval of the crew department. Attach and paste the 
original tickets at the back of the reimbursement document in the order from left to right. 
1.5 船舶物料、备件、海图、修理等零星支出 
Other petty expenses on ship stores, spare parts, charts, and repairs  
 船舶物料、备件、海图等除零星支出外，船舶一般不得以现金支付，一律由公司
统一结算。如遇特殊情况，确需船舶支付现金的，需向公司主管人员请示，经批
准后方可购买的，凭单据支付现金。 
Except the petty expenses on ship stores, spare parts, and chart, etc, other expenses shall be settled 
account by company and shall not be paid by cashes on t ship. In case of special circumstances, if 
master pay in cash, should report to the supervisor and take the approval of the supervisor.  
 船舶所有支出，取得发票的，不再填写其他自制单据。 
No need to fill in other self-made receipt for all the expenses with invoices. 
2.0 船舶报账办法 
Ship reimbursement instructions 
2.1 每月的船舶支出数在下月5 日前通过电子邮件发至公司邮箱，船员部收到后，2 日内
对报账清单内容予以审核、回复。 
 Send the monthly ship account to the company's with e-mail before 5th of next month, the crew 
department shall audit the reimbursement documents and reply back within 2 days after receiving the 
email. 

管理须知手册                         版次/修改：3.0/6.0                      INS-13 
Instruction Manual                     Version/Rev.: 3.0/6.0                      INS-13 
   青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                  生效日期：2026/04/15         第2/2页 
   Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd      Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 2/2 
2.2 船舶靠港后，原始报账单据通过公司上船人员带回交给船员部，不能带回的，应已特
快专递邮寄公司。 
After the ship berth, the original reimbursement documents shall be taken back by the on board personnel 
from the company and delivered to the crew dept. For the documents that can not be taken back, should 
mail it to the company by express. 
2.3 各船舶应注意报账的及时性，月初及时发送报账清单，靠港后及时邮寄原始账单。如
遇特殊情况不能按时发送或邮寄的，应及时发邮件通知船员部。 
Each ship shall pay attention to the timeliness of the reimbursement, send the reimbursement documents 
in time at the beginning of each month, and mail the original bill in time after arriving at the port. The 
reimbursement documents can not be sent or mailed in case of special circumstance, notify the crew 
department by email in time. 
3.0 船舶账务交接 
Ship financial handover 
交接时注意做好以下几项工作： 
Pay attention to the following items when handover: 
3.1 认真盘点库存现金、船存伙食及招待物品，做到船帐与实际情况相符。交接现金时，
要特别注意是否有残损现钞。 
Count the balance cash, food，and entertaining items carefully, to ensure that the ship account is 
consistent with the actual situation, When handover the cash, pay special attention if there is damaged 
cash or not. 
3.2 需要移交的船存伙食及招待物品，要逐项列出清单，列出数量及金额，并由船长，大
厨、三副及接受方签字。 
List the ship food and entertainment items for handover in detail, with the number and amount, ship 
master, Chief Cook, Third Officer and the receiving party shall sign on the list. 
3.3 交接时，如发现残损变质伙食、招待物品或者船账与实际不符现象，应及时查找原因
并书面报公司。 
While handover, any situation is found, such as food deterioration, entertainment items or ship’s account 
are found to be inconsistent with the actual situation, find the reasons promptly and report to the company 
in writing.

03_30_0.text:
第十四章 船员管理办法 
Chapter 14 Crew Management Regulation 
 
1 
总则 General principles 
1.1 
为了加强船员队伍建设，规范和促进船员管理工作，维护船员管理工作的正常秩序，
确保安全优质地完成运输生产任务，根据国家有关政策和规定，结合我司实际，特
制定本办法。 
This procedure is hereby formulated according to the relevant national policies and regulations, 
combining with our company actual situations to strengthen the construction of the crew team, 
standardize and promote the crew management, maintain the normal order of the crew management, 
and ensure completing the transport safely and in good quality. 
1.2 
本办法是船员管理工作的主要依据，也是船员应当遵守的行为规范，各级领导和全
体船员必须认真执行，严格遵守。 
This regulation is the main basis for the crew management and the behavioral norms that the crew shall 
comply with, which leaders at all levels and the crew must carefully implement and strictly abide by. 
2 
海员职业发展和技能开发Seafarer career development and skills development 
2.1 
公司强化培训Company strengthen training 
培训内容主要包括：企业文化、安全意识，提高干部船员业务水平的培训；驾驶员
航海/商务业务知识与技能/GMDSS 操作等培训；轮机长、轮机员机舱管理业务知识
与技能提高培训；普通船员工作技能的培训；船长、轮机长管理水平提高的培训等。
上述培训要根据船舶生产和船员公休需要综合考虑安排，具体培训方法：见《程序
手册》中第十四章关于《船员培训控制程序》的规定。 
Training mainly includes: corporate culture, safety awareness, training of improving the professional 
skills of officers; Deck officers /business knowledge and skills/ GMDSS operation and other training; 
training of improving management knowledge and skills of the chief engineers and engineers; work 
skills training of ratings; training of improving management skills of the master and chief engineers. 
The above trainings should be arranged based on board and crew’s vacation. Specific training methods: 
see Chapter 14 of the Procedure Manual on Crew Training Control Procedure. 
2.2 
在船培训及见习   Training on board and probation 
船舶领导和部门负责人必须对在船船员科学管理、严格要求，重视对他们的工作安
全教育、职业道德和敬业精神及工作责任心的教育。并依据船员在船培训的有关规
定对在船船员进行培训。具体培训方法：见《程序手册》中第十四章关于《船员培
训控制程序》的规定。 
The ship leaders and department heads must carry out the principle of scientific management and strict 
requirement to the crew in ship, and pay more attention to their work safety education, professional 
ethics and professionalism education and sense of responsibility education as well. Provide training to 
the crew in ship in accordance with the relevant provisions. Specific training methods: see Chapter 14 
of the Procedure Manual on Crew Training Control Procedure. 
2.3 
船员考核Crew assessment 
2.3.1 考核办法Measures for assessing  

131

管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14

（1） 船员考核工作是船员管理工作的一个重要组成部分，是做好船员调配、提升任免和
培训工作的前提，也是掌握船员技术业务状况、加强船员管理的一项基础工作。 
The crew assessment is an important part of the crew management. It is the prerequisite for the crew 
deployment, promotion, appointment and dismissal, and training; and also the basic to learn the 
technical status of the crew and strengthen the management of the crew. 
（2） 考核范围：在船船员均列入本考核范围。Assessment range: All crew on board are. 
（3） 考核内容主要是：职业道德、敬业精神、工作责任心、安全意识、工作业绩、团结
协作、组织纪律观念、技术业务水平、组织领导和管理能力、身体状况等。 
The assessments cover: professional ethics, professionalism, sense of responsibility, safety awareness, 
work performance, unity and cooperation, sense of organizational discipline, technical level, 
management skills and leadership, and physical condition. 
（4） 考核周期及具体方法：见《船舶手册》中有关《船员在船工作考核办法》的规定。
Assessment period and specific measures: refer to the Measures of Assessing the Crew on Boarding the 
Ship Manual. 
2.4 
职务晋升Promotion 
2.4.1 审批程序Approval procedure 
（1） 船员提职，在取得相应职务证书、在船表现良好后，遵循本人申请、船舶推荐、公
司审批的程序。 
For the promotion of the crew with corresponding job certificate and good performance on board, 
follow the process of personal application, recommendation by ship, and approval by the company. 
（2） 基本要求见下表，由船长签署意见报公司船员部。

3 
船员调配管理规程Crew deployment management regulations 
3.1 
调配原则The principle of deployment 
3.1.1 调配船员要坚持有利于生产、有利于安全、有利于船员资源的合理利用和企业的效
益；坚持个人服从集体、下级服从上级的原则。 
Crew shall be deployed on the basis of benefiting the production, security, the rational use of the crew 
resources and business efficiency; and following the principle of subordination of the individual to the 
collective, subordination of the inferiors to the superior. 
3.1.2 
船长和大副、轮机长和大管轮一般不得同时换班，若有原船或同类型船舶资历人员
返船时，不受此限制。 
Generally, the captain and the C/O, as well as the C/E and 2E, shall not change shifts simultaneously. 
This restriction does not apply when crew members with experience on the original ship or ships of the 
same type return to the ship. 
3.1.3 
如特殊情况下，无法满足上述情况时，需要根据表格“特殊换班评估报告INS-13-01”

133

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 4/11 
 
的要求对换班情况进行说明和评估，经批准后方可进行换班。 
In special circumstances where the above conditions cannot be met, the form “Crew Special Change 
Assessment Report INS-13-01” must be used to explain and assess the crew change situation， and 
crew changes may only be made after approval has been obtained. 
3.1.4 新聘及转岗船员未经过上船前培训的不准派船。 
Newly recruited and transferred crews who have not received before boarding training are not allowed 
to be deployed on board. 
3.1.5 不满十八周岁的船员（包括见习人员）不得派船。 
The crew aged less than 18 years old (including trainees) shall not be dispatched on board. 
3.2 
调配程序Procedure of deployment 
3.2.1 公司按《船长和船员的审核调配程序》为管理的船舶配备船员。 
The company man seafarers for a ship according to the "Review and Deployment Procedures for 
Master and Crew". 
3.2.2 船抵国内港口后，船员部应据情派人上船考察了解船员生活工作情况，检查船上对有
关规章制度的执行情况、船舶班子的整体配合情况等，现场处理并向公司反映船上
存在的有关问题。 
When the ship arrives at the domestic port, the Crew Department shall send a person to the ship to 
investigate the work and living condition of the crew, inspect the implementation of the relevant rules 
and regulations on board, the cooperation of the ship team, etc., deal with the problem existed at site 
and report to the company. 
3.2.3 在船人员变动时，船长必须及时更新SMIS 中的船员名单。 
In the event of crew changes, the master must timely update the crew list in SMIS. 
3.3 
调配要求Deploying Requirements 
3.3.1 调配人员要基本了解所管船舶的种类、吨位、主机类型、性能特点和设备目前的技术
状况，掌握干部船员和基本掌握普通船员的现实表现、文化程度、技术业务能力、
性格特点、健康状况及家庭情况等。调配船员要考虑管理级船员的配合情况，优先
考虑配备有较好合作经历的船员同船。 
The deploy superintendent should have a basic understanding of the ship type, tonnage, engine type, 
performance and current technical condition, learn the seafarers’ performance, education background, 
the technical ability, characters, healthy and the family. Consider the coordination of the executive 
ship’s officers and give priority to the crews with better cooperation experience. 
3.3.2 公司制定的各船舶配员标准要达到船旗国最低安全配员标准并符合安全及防污设备
证书要求、船舶舱室证书要求。 
The on board manning document which is drawn up by company shall meet the minimum safe 
manning standards of flag state and meet their requirements on the safety and anti-pollution equipment 
certificate and crew accommodation certificate. 
3.3.3 配备船员应符合船舶类型等的需要。特别注意对大吨位船舶的船长、大副的配备，对
自动化船舶的轮机长和电机员的配备，其它类型船舶，也要根据各自的特点配备相
应的人员。 
The manning seafarers shall match with the ship type etc. Especially pay attention to the manning 
Master and Chief Officer for cape-size ship, the manning Chief Engineer and Electrician Engineer for

according

characteristics. 
3.3.4 在特殊情况下出现的定员范围内减员，属三副、三管轮以上干部船员，必须设法从速
补齐，确保船舶在适航状态下航行。属于一般船员的减员，也要在符合《船舶最低
配员证书》要求的基础上征得船舶领导的同意后再决定少补或不补。 
The reducing seafarer in the case of special circumstances such as position above of Third officer and 
Fourth Engineer, try should fill in the vacant position rapidly, ensure the ship navigate at seaworthy 
condition. The other positions vacant of ordinary crew shall be less filled or not filled with the approval 
of the ship leaders on the basis of complying the requirement of "Minimum Safe manning Certificate” 
of the ship. 
3.3.5 凡船员自述患病，经查属实或经体检发现患有疾病的，不符合健康要求的，调配人员
不得派其上船。已上船船员如发现患有传染性疾病或危重病者，无论船在国内国外，
都要尽快调其下船医治。 
The crew who claims to have disease or does not comply the health requirement, once proved 
to be 
true after investigation or by medical examination, shall not be deployed on  board. If the crew on 
board is found to have infectious disease or critical disease, arrange him off the ship to accept cure as 
soon as possible. 
3.4 
调配审核的分工与协作Deployment cooperation and division 
3.4.1 船员部对拟派船员进行审核，对其证书的有效性、健康状况、服务资历的真实性、技
术能力、管理水平、性格等进行综合把关。 
The Crew Department review the crew for deployment, including the certificate validity, the health 
condition, the service qualification truth, the technical capacity, the management level and the character 
etc. 
3.4.2 船管部负责对轮机部高级船员的技术业务能力进行面试、审核把关。 
The Fleet Department is responsible for interviewing and reviewing the technical ability of the officers 
in the Engine Department. 
3.4.3 海务部负责对甲板部高级船员的技术业务能力进行面试、审核把关 
The Marine Department is responsible for interviewing the technical ability of the officers in the Deck 
Department. 
4 
在船船员管理 Crew management on board 
4.1 
领导责任Leader’s responsibility 
抓好在船船员的管理是做好船舶管理工作的重要环节。公司领导和有关部门的人员
应经常深入船舶检查、指导、支持和帮助船舶领导工作。船长是船东的代表，在船
行使船东对本船的管理职责，有权对工作表现不良的船员按程序进行调整处理。船
长和各部门负责人应以身作则、同心协力、严格要求，按各自的职责和有关规定切
实做好对船员的思想教育和安全管理，保证船舶各项工作安全顺利进行。 
How to manage the crew well is an important part of the ship management. Company leaders and 
relevant departments shall go frequently to ship for inspection, guidance, support and help the work of 
the ship leader. The master, as the representative of the ship owner, perform the duty of management 
instead of the owner, and has the right to adjust and deal with the crew with poor performance. The 
master and department leaders shall discipline themselves, cooperate together, strict requirement and 
carry out the ideological education and safety management of the crew according to their duties and the 

135

管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/10.0                   INS-14  
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                             生效日期：2026/04/15               第6/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 6/11 
 
relevant provisions. 
4.2 
学习与教育Learn and education 
4.2.1 船舶领导要根据公司的部署和要求坚持各种学习和会议制度，学习公司体系文件和
资讯等，努力提高船员的综合素质。 
The ship leaders shall, in accordance with the company's deployment and requirements, keep learning 
the company system documents and information, and strive to improve the overall quality of the crew. 
4.2.2 船舶领导要经常有针对性地对船员进行忠于职守、忠于企业、忠于国家和团队精神
的教育，加强对船员业务知识的指导，使船员能够在遵纪守法、安全生产、做好本
职工作的基础上良好协作，共同完成航次任务。 
The ship leaders shall implement the education of being loyal to the enterprise, to the nation, company 
and team spirit to the crew, strengthen the guidance of the professional knowledge to the crew, so that 
the crew can cooperate with each other well and complete the voyage on the basis of complying with 
the law, producing safely, and operating his job efficiently. 
4.3 
组织纪律Organizational discipline 
4.3.1 船员要认真遵守国际和国家有关法律和法规。 
The crew shall abide by the relevant international and national laws and regulations. 
4.3.2 船员必须执行公司和上级制定的作息制度、请销假制度、交接班制度和其它有关规章
制度。 
The crew must carry out the routine regulation, work attendance regulation, handover regulation and 
other relevant rules and regulations. 
4.3.3 船员要服从公司的调动，按要求及时上船工作，严禁延误船期或漏船。延误船期按损
失金额由个人支付部分或全部费用，漏船者按旷工处理。船员应积极参加船上组织
的学习和各种会议，不得无故缺席、迟到和早退，否则按旷工处理。 
The crew shall obey the company's redeployment and be on board timely according to the requirements. 
Shipment delays or miss ship are strictly prohibited. Missing the ship is deemed as absenteeism. The 
crew should take an active part in the study and meetings organized on board, and shall not be absent, 
late and leave early for no reason. 
4.3.4 船员之间要团结友爱、互相协作，不得拉帮结派、挑拨事非、寻衅闹事、打架斗殴。
凡在船出现打架、偷盗等事件，并因此而被遣返者，路费自理；公司调查后将提出
行政和经济处罚，严重者将被终止合同。 
The crews shall unity and mutually cooperate with each other. No gang up, no provoking,  no 
fight. 
Anyone who is repatriated for fighting or stealing on board, shall pay their own travelling expenses and 
will be punished administratively and economically after  the investigation by the company. The 
service contract of the crew who violates these regulations greatly will be terminated. 
4.3.5 船员要爱护公共财物，不得随便拆动生产工具和房间内的固定设施。 
The crew shall take care of public property and shall not disassemble the production tools and the fixed 
facilities in the room. 
4.3.6 船员要自觉维护船舶工作、生产和生活秩序，不准酗酒，在值班期间和接班前4 小时
内不准饮酒或酒精饮料，严禁打麻将和进行任何形式的赌博活动。如有以上情况，
公司将进行经济处罚和行政处罚。 
The crew shall consciously maintain the order of the work, production and life on board. Not allowed 

136

管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14
