to drink excessive. No Drink on duty and 4 hours before taking over the job. No gambling activities in 
any form including mahjong. The company will carry out economic penalties and administrative 
penalties for any of the above situation. 
4.3.7 家属和亲友来港探亲，应办理登轮手续并注意自身安全。船长应向船员家属提供安全
须知，如因家属个人原因违反安全须知，船员家属在船发生人身伤亡事故由船员本
人和家属自己负责。 
Family members, relatives and friends, who come to visit on board, shall go through the procedures on 
board and pay attention to their own safety. The master shall provide the Safety Instructions to the 
family members of the crew, and the crew members themselves shall be responsible for their personal 
injury or death in the event of breaching the safety instructions due to personal reasons. 
4.4 
劳动纪律Labor discipline 
4.4.1 船员要认真履行职责，服从工作分配，保质保量地完成所承担的任务。对分配的工作
或工作中的问题可提出不同意见和改进建议，但不得消极怠工和顶撞、漫骂、威胁
领导。如有违反，公司将就近遣返并严肃处理。 
The crew should strictly perform their duties, follow the distribution of work, complete successfully the 
task guaranteed. There may be disagreements and suggestions for the assignment of work, but do not 
work-to-rule, do not contradict, abuse, or threaten the leader. In case of violation, the company will 
repatriate the violator and deal with it severely. 
4.4.2 船员在船工作要坚持不迟到、不早退、不无故旷工，遵守请销假制度。 
The crew shall follow the work attendance regulation, do not come to work late and leave early and no 
absent from work without reason. 
4.4.3 船员要认真履行岗位职责，执行各项操作规程，严格遵守《船舶手册》规定、防火防
爆防污染，严禁违章作业。 
The crew shall fulfill their duties carefully, implement the operating procedures, comply strictly with 
the Ship Manual regulations, to prevent the fire, explosion and pollution from happening. Do not work 
against the regulation. 
4.4.4 船员要遵守船舶航行、停泊值班及船舶保安等制度和其他有关规定，保证船舶和人身
安全。 
The crew shall comply with the ship navigation regulation, berthing and duty regulation, ship security 
regulations and other relevant provisions to ensure the ships and personal safety. 
4.4.5 船员值班中要尽职尽责，坚守岗位，按规定着装，不做与值班无关的事情。当班人员
向接班人员交代工作要清楚。未经领导同意不得私自调换值班时间。 
The crew shall be conscientious and responsible on duty, and stay at their stations. Dress as regulation 
and do not do anything that has nothing to do with the job. The duty officer shall hand over the work 
clearly to the take-over duty. Do not change shifting time without approval from leaders. 
4.4.6 船长应采取有效措施防止疲劳操作，并按船旗国主管当局关于劳动时间的规定执行。
The master shall take effective measures to prevent the fatigue operation and the working time shall be 
carried out in accordance with the provisions of the competent authorities of the flag State. 
4.5 
涉外纪律 Discipline in foreign countries 
4.5.1 船员要遵守所到国家和地区的法律、法规以及当地和港口的有关规定，尊重当地的风
俗习惯。船员携带符合规定的烟酒等物品应主动向海关书面申报。不得藏带麻醉品

137

管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/10.0                   INS-14

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 8/11 
 
和其他违禁品；不得收看或携带淫秽录像和非法视频等；不得走私文物动植物和其
标本。不得偷窃盗卖船上物品和货物。严格遵守执行出入境的外汇货币管理规定。
如船员违反如上法律法规公司将移交当地机关并追究给公司和船舶造成的损失赔
偿。  
Crew members must abide by the laws, regulations and relevant provisions of the local 
authorities and ports of the countries and regions they visit, and respect local customs and 
practices. Crew members carrying items such as tobacco and alcohol in compliance with 
regulations should proactively declare them in writing to the customs. no conceal or carry 
narcotic drugs or other contraband; no watch or carry pornographic videos or illegal 
videos, etc.; no smuggle cultural relics, animals, plants and their specimens. no steal or 
sell items or goods on board. The crews must strictly comply with the regulations on 
foreign exchange and currency management for entry and exit. If crew members violate 
the above laws and regulations, the company will hand them over to the local authorities 
and hold them accountable for the losses caused to the company and the vessel. 
4.5.2 严禁嫖妓和让妓女登轮，严禁进入不健康场所。 
No prostitution and no allowed prostitutes on board. Entering the prostitution places is strictly 
prohibited. 
4.5.3 船员下地购物应到正当的贸易场所，不得走家串户购物。严禁购买旧商品。严禁拣拾、
偷拿任何物品和以物易物。严禁在国外出售、倒卖烟酒及其他物品。违反者公司将
严肃处理。 
The crew shall go to the legitimate market for shopping. Do not buy goods door by door. Buying old 
goods, picking up or steal any item and barter are strictly prohibited, as well as selling alcohol or 
cigarette or other items abroad. Violator will be dealt with severely by company. 
4.5.4 不准接受贿赂和变相受贿。正常业务往来中所得礼品、钱物，必须由船舶领导按有关
规定处理。 
Bribes in any form is not allowed.  The gifts, money and goods received in normal business must be 
disposed by ship leaders in accordance with the relevant provisions. 
4.6 
船员登岸 Shore leave to Crew  
4.6.1 船员在国外港口登岸，船舶领导可根据船期和所在港口情况，在确保船舶生产和安全
的前提下，安排船员分批下地活动。 
Crew leave to shore in a foreign port, under the premise of ensuring the production and safety of the 
ship, the ship leader can arrange the crew leave to shore in shift as the ship’s schedule and the port 
situation. 
4.6.2 船员在国外港口下地，须二人以上同行。 
Go with the accompany of the other crew when leaving to shore in foreign port. 
4.6.3 船员离船必须向本部门负责人或船舶领导请假，回船后及时销假。船舶领导、部门负
责人登岸时，还应向有关人员交待好工作，并说明去向或留下联系方法。船长和大
副、轮机长和大管轮、水手长和木匠不得同时离船。船员最迟必须在开航前二小时
或夜间10 点前返回船舶。 
The crew must ask the department or ship leader for a leave when leaving the ship and report back after 
return. The ship leader and department head shall hand over job to the relevant personnel and explain 
where to go and how to contact. The master and Chief Officer, chief engineer and Second engineer, 

138

03_30_2.chapter: 第十四章 船员管理办法
03_30_2.text:
管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/10.0                   INS-14  
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                             生效日期：2026/04/15               第9/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 9/11 
 
Bosun and Carpenter shall not leave the ship at the same time. The crew must return to the ship at least 
two hours before departure or before 10 pm. 
4.7 
医疗卫生Medical and hygiene 
4.7.1 全体船员要认真执行《海事劳工管理手册》中《生活设施和饮食》的规定，要经常保
持船上室内外卫生。注意防病除病，防止食物中毒，经常检查公共场所和船员房间
个人卫生。 
All crew members shall conscientiously implement the provisions of Living Facilities and Catering in 
Maritime Labour Management, and shall keep the ship clean. Prevent diseases and food poisoning, 
check the hygiene in public area and crew’s cabins on board. 
4.7.2 船长须确保该船按照《国际船舶医疗指南》中‘推荐药品和医疗设备表’结合船舶类
型、营运航线、船员数量储备足够的药物和医疗物品。 
The master shall reserve sufficient medicines and medical articles in accordance with 'List of 
Recommended Medical and Medical Equipment' in INTERNATIONAL MEDICAL GUIDE FOR SHIPS, 
considering the ship type, route, crew numbers. 
4.7.3 船长须采取一切所需措施，预防传染病在船员中蔓延，若有需要，可经由代理人向港
口卫生当局索取关于传染病、流行病的最新资料，以保障船员的在船健康。 
The master shall take all necessary measures to prevent the spread of infectious diseases among the 
crew and, if necessary, obtain the latest information on infectious diseases and epidemics from the local 
quarantine authority in the port via the agent, to protect the crew's health on  board. 
4.7.4 凡发现船员伤病不适合在船工作的，要及时报告公司船员部，调岸治疗。有隐瞒病情
或找人替代者，公司将给予经济处罚。 
If the injured and ill crew is not suitable for work on board, report to the Crew Department and arrange 
the crew to get treatment ashore. Any concealing in the disease or crew replacement will be penalized 
financially by the company. 
4.7.5 船员在船患病或负伤，一般应在船就医。如病情或伤情严重，在船上无法确诊和治疗
时，由船长提出建议，船员部批准后，可通知代理安排或到公司指定的当地医院治
疗。Crew, who get sick or injured on board, generally shall be medically treated on board. In case of 
serious disease or injury which can not be diagnosed and treated on board, notify the agent to make 
arrangements or send the crew to the hospital designated by the company with the recommendation of 
the master and the approval of the Crew Department. 
4.7.6 船员在船因伤病需要休息的，经部门负责人同意后，可予以安排，需要做病号饭的由
大副或轮机长通知大厨安排。 
The crew on board with injury or disease can be arranged for rest with the approval of the department 
head. If necessary, notify the Chief Cook to prepare the special food for patients by Chief Officer or 
Chief Engineer. 
4.8 
着装仪表Dress and appearance 
4.8.1 船员在国内外港口登岸时，均要着装整洁，注意仪表。 
The crew shall pay attention to the proper dress and appearance when going to shore at the domestic 
and foreign port. 
4.8.2 严禁在国外穿军服、工作服和拖鞋、工作鞋下地。 
It is strictly forbidden to wear military uniforms, working uniforms and working shoes when landing in 

139

管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/10.0                   INS-14  
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                             生效日期：2026/04/15               第10/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 10/11 
 
foreign countries. 
4.8.3 在船期间，船员不得穿工作服、工作鞋、拖鞋、背心、内裤进入餐厅用餐。 
The crew shall not go to the restaurant for meal wearing working uniforms, working shoes, slippers, 
vests, and underwear when on board. 
4.8.4 船长在船上工作始终应着装干净整齐，体现出船长的威严和形象。 
The master shall always keep neat and tidy on board, reflecting the majesty and image as the master. 
4.8.5 大厨和服务员在膳食制作时需穿着工作服和戴工作帽，严禁穿背心、拖鞋。 
Chef cook and steward must wear working uniforms and working cap in the preparation of meals. Vests 
and slippers are strictly prohibited to wear. 
5 
船员请休假制度Regulations on Vocation  
5.1 
公休假Public vocation 
5.1.1 各职务船员连续在船工作9 个月，船员部可以安排其休假。如确因工作需要或船舶所
在港口条件限制，船员部可提早或推迟安排其休假，原则上提早或推迟不应超过2
个月。 
The Crew Department can arrange crew who work continuously for 9 months on board, to have the 
leave. The Crew Department may advance or postpone the arrangement of the leave if it is limited by 
the working needs or the conditions of the port. In principle, the leave shall not be advanced or 
postponed more than 2 months. 
5.1.2 船员休假期与待派Crew’s vacation and assignment 
船员实行综合计算工时制，实行轮班工作，集中公休方式。公休期按在船工作5 天
休息2 天计算。船员享有带薪年休假：船员每在船工作2 个月给予5 天带薪年休假。 
The working time of the crew is calculated comprehensively. Work in shift. The public vacation is 
arranged centrally, work 5 days and 2 days off. The crew have the paid annual leave: get 5days paid 
annual leave for every 2 months work on board. 
5.1.3 如因违纪违规被遣返者，被遣返者需要支付路费。 
The crew shall pay the travelling expenses by themselves if they are repatriated for violation of 
discipline. 
5.2 
病假Sick leave 
5.2.1 船员在船期间因潜在或器质性疾病需要离船治疗，在国外，由公司通过代理安排并由
公司支付初期治疗费用；在国内，由代理安排或本人直接到国内港口医院检查并由
本人垫付费用，如不能随船工作需要回家治疗，医药费按公司医疗办法执行。船员
待派期间患病，应向船员部提供县级以上医院连续病假证明，按病假处理。 
When the crew needs to leave the ship for treatment due to potential or organic disease, the treatment 
will be arranged by the agency and the initial treatment expenses will be paid by company if it is in the 
foreign country; If it is in domestic, the treatment can be arranged by the agency or the crew himself 
can go to the hospital at domestic port for inspection and pay the treatment costs first. If the crew can 
not work on board and has to go home for treatment, medical expenses are carried out according to the 
company medical measures. If the crew takes a disease during the period to be dispatched, report to the 
Crew Department and provide the certificate for sick leave from hospital above the county level, and 
the leave will be recorded as sick leave. 

140

管理须知手册                           版本/修改：3.0/10.0                      INS-14  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/10.0                   INS-14  
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                             生效日期：2026/04/15               第11/11页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 11/11 
 
5.2.2 船员如病愈要求上船，并经公司指定的医院复查必要时须经劳动鉴定委员会确认后，
方可安排上船工作，所花费用由船员自理（工伤除外）。 
After the health condition of the crew is rechecked in the hospital designated by the company and 
confirmed by the Labor Identification Committee, the cured crew can be rearranged to work on board.  
All the cost shall be borne by the crew themselves (except work injury). 
5.3 
上岸假期Shore leave 
5.3.1 严格控制在船船员请假。特殊情况确需请上岸假期者，在不影响生产和工作的前提下，
由船长根据情况办理。船员请上岸假期期间的工作，由船舶领导和部门负责人妥善
安排，在国内港口如由船员部派人临时顶替，将停发请假船员工资，所需的交通费
由本人自理。如船员不请假随意上岸，发生漏船耽误船期或其他意外均由本人承担
责任。The leave of the crew on board shall be controlled strictly. If the crew needs to ask for shore 
leave for special circumstances, the master handle with it under the premise of not affecting the 
production and works. The ship and department leaders shall properly arrange the ship’s work for the 
crew shore leave. If the Crew Department send other crew instead of the crew on leave in the domestic 
port, the wages of the crew on leave will stop to be paid, the required transportation costs will be borne 
by the crew themselves. The crew shall take all the responsibilities for missing ship, departure delay, or 
other accidents arising from going on shore without permit. 
5.4 
船员工伤Injury in working 
5.4.1 船员因工负伤，船长应立即组织有关人员进行必要的抢救和护理，船员严重伤病应按
《船舶应急反应程序》(CONP-04)执行，如船长判断船员的伤情不需要启动应急反应
可立即通知船员部处理，并按《不符合规定情况、事故和险情的报告程序》向海务
部报送事故报告，同时抄报船员部。报告应包括如下内容：事故发生的时间、地点、
原因、伤残部位及救治情况。船员伤愈后持医院诊断说明经公司确认后，申请工伤
鉴定。因工负伤船员在治疗期间，必须有县级以上医院开具的与工伤部位有关的连
续诊断证明，方可享受工伤工资待遇。 
If the crew is injured for work, the master shall immediately organize the relevant personnel to carry 
out the necessary rescue and treatment. The serious injury of the crew shall be carried out according to 
the Ship’s Emergency Response Procedure(CONP-04). If the master judges that the crew's injury does 
not need to start the emergency response, can notify the Crew Department to deal with and send 
accident report to the Marine Department according to Report and handling procedure of 
Non-Conformities, Accidents and Hazardous Occurrences (PRO-06), and copy to the Crew Department. 
The report shall include the following: time and date of injury, location on ship, cause, injury parts and 
treatment given onboard. After recovery, the crew can apply for work injury authenticate with the 
diagnosis certificate issued by the hospital and confirmed by the company. During the treatment, the 
injured crew can get the pay for injury with the continuous diagnosis certificate of the injury part issued 
by the hospital at or above the county level. 
5.4.2 船员部负责伤、病船员在国内的后续治疗安排及有关费用的结算和补偿事宜。 
The Crew Department is in charge of the follow-up treatment, arrangements and related costs 
settlement and compensation matters for the injury or illness crew at his country.

03_31.chapter: 第十五章 机务日常管理办法
03_31.text:
第十五章 机务日常管理办法 
Chapter 15 Daily management regulations of Technical Superintendent 
 
1.0 目的和范围  
Purpose and scope 
1.1 规定对机务人员（船管部所属的工作人员）日常管理工作的要求，保证机务人员对船
舶实施有效的监控，使船舶处于稳定的技术状况。 
Regulate daily management requirements to the technical superintendent (all staff in the fleet department), 
ensure the technical superintendent monitors the ship effectively and make the ship keep in a stable 
technical status. 
1.2 本办法适用于公司船管部和公司所管理的船舶。 
This regulation is applicable to the Fleet Department and ships managed by the company. 
2.0 职责 
Responsibility 
2.1 机务人员：负责对所管船舶的船级证书及检验报告的审核、来往函电的处理、  
机务报表的审阅、物料备件的管理、通导设备维护修理、船舶厂修和航修等有关事宜
的安排、船舶各项经济指标的监控及登轮检查。 
Technical superintendent: responsible for inspecting on board, monitoring economic indicators of the ship 
and arranging the following related issues, including ship class certificate and survey report review, 
correspondence handling, technical report review, ship store and spare parts management, navigation 
equipment maintenance and repair, dock and voyage repair, etc. 
2.2 船管部副经理：负责监督和指导机务人员的日常的管理工作并向部门经理汇报。 
Deputy Manager of Fleet Department: responsible for supervising and guiding the daily management 
work of the technical superintendent and reporting to the department manager. 
2.3 船管部经理：负责监控本部门日常管理工作中的重点问题的，协调各部门与本部门之
间的关系。 
Manager of Fleet Department: responsible for monitoring the key issues in the daily management of 
department and coordinating the relationship between the departments. 
3.0 工作程序   
Working procedure 
3.1 来往函电的处理  
Deal with correspondence  
3.1.1 机务人员每天要认真审阅、处理船舶上报的各种函电，正确理解函电内容。 
Technical superintendent shall review and deal with correspondences mail and reported to senior every 
day, understand the contents of the correspondence correctly. 
3.1.2 对函电的答复要及时。无论对函电所述问题有无明确解决方案，均应及时将问题解决
的实际进度通知船舶。工作时间内自收到船舶函电的，4 小时内答复船舶；非工作时
间收到的，应在24 小时内答复船舶。一旦有了明确的解决方案要立即通知船舶。 
Response to correspondences mail timely. Regardless of whether there is a clear solution to the problem 
described in the correspondences mail or not, revert the actual progress of the problem solution to the 
ship in time. Response shall be made within 4 hours from the time of receiving the correspondence in 
working time. For correspondence received at non-working time, response shall be made within 24 
hours. Once there is a clear solution, notify the ship immediately. 
3.2 机务报表的审阅  
Technical report check and approve  
3.2.1 机务报表即为SMIS 中的相关技术报表和部分没有纳入SMIS 的表格。 
The technical report is the related technical report in SMIS and the form that is not included in SMIS. 
3.2.2 对于船舶结构状况报告，要从船舶结构安全的角度和延长结构使用寿命的角度进行审

管理须知手册                        版本/修改：3.0/4.0                         INS-15 
Shorebase Instruction Manual            Version/Revise: 3.0/4.0                       INS-15 
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                   生效日期：2026/04/15              第2/3页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2026/04/15                Page: 2/3 
核。对发现问题，要结合船舶的航次任务及航行区域的特点综合考虑，制定出合理的、
切实可行的解决方案，经本部门经理同意后及时反馈给船舶。解决方案反馈船舶后要
随时跟踪直至方案完全落实。 
For the ship structure status report, check it from the perspective of the safety of the ship structure and 
extending the service life of the structure. Considering the problem found by combining the ship's voyage 
task and the characteristics of the navigation area, and formulate a reasonable and feasible solution. Feed 
back the solution to the ship in time with the approval of the department manager and follow up the 
implementation of the solution until it is fully implemented. 
3.2.3 在SMIS 中报送的维护保养报告与计划不相符合时，机务人员要及时反馈给船舶，了
解原因并和船舶进行沟通重新确定相应的保养方案。 
When the maintenance report submitted in SMIS is not consistent with the plan, the technical 
superintendent shall inform the ship in time, check the causes and communicate with the ship to 
re-determine the corresponding maintenance plan. 
3.2.4 对于日常维护保养工作，机务人员可根据船舶航行区域海况、航行时间及船舶待港时
间，可要求船舶在SMIS 中以“船建临时工作单”的形式制定相关的维修保养计划，
并监督和落实。 
For daily maintenance, the technical superintendent may, in accordance with the conditions of the ship 
navigating area, the voyage time and waiting time at port, require the ship to formulate maintenance plan 
in the form of "Temporary Working Sheet Created by Ship" in SMIS, supervise and implement it. 
3.2.5 对于设备技术状况报告，要从设备运转的完好程度及保证设备正常使用寿命的角度考
虑.如果发现问题，要结合设备的重要程度、所带来的安全隐患程度、设备价值及船舶
航次任务的经济效益进行综合考虑，以制定出合理的、切实可行的解决方案，经部门
经理同意后及时反馈给船舶，并监督落实。 
The technical status report of the equipment shall be considered from the perspective of the normal 
operation and the normal service life of the equipment. Consider the problem found by combining the 
importance of the equipment, the degree of safety hazard, the value of the equipment and the economy 
benefits of the ship's mission, and formulate a reasonable and feasible solution. Report the solution to the 
ship in time with the approval of the department manager and follow up the implementation of the 
solution until it is fully implemented. 
4.0 燃、润料的日常管理 
Daily management of the fuel and the lubricant oil 
4.1 机务人员负责核实确定船舶正常营运时的燃油日耗量、航速和主机转速作为租船合同
的依据； 
The technical superintendents are responsible for verifying the daily fuel consumption, speed and main 
engine speed as the basis for the ship chartering contract; 
4.2 机务人员在登轮检查时应； 
When boarding, the technical superintendent shall check; 
 负责监督测量船舶燃油的储量，核对《轮机日志》和《船舶测量与调驳记录簿》并
进行修正。 
Responsible for monitoring the ship's fuel reserves, check Engine Log Book and Ship Bunker 
Sounding and Transfer Records and make corrections. 
 落实燃油流量表的使用情况和工作情况；在期间检验和特检修船时安排对流量表的
校核和加装确保正常使用； 
Confirm the service condition of the fuel flow meter; Arrange the calibration and installation of the 
flow meter when repairing ship during intermediate survey and special survey.  
4.3 机务总管负责及时安排燃油添加剂的供应，确保燃油得到有效的处理和合理使用； 
The technical superintendent is responsible for arranging the supply of fuel additives in time to ensure 
that the fuel is treated effectively and used rationally;

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.       Effective Date: 2026/04/15                Page: 3/3 
4.4 机务人员每天要查看正午报告，定期核对燃油及滑油航次报表，及时监控船上每天的
燃油消耗、滑油消耗和航速、主机转速。如果发现异常或不符合要求的情况，要马上
向船方进行询问，弄清原因并提出解决方案， 
The technical superintendent shall check the noon report every day, check the fuel and lubricant voyage 
report regularly, monitor the daily fuel consumption, lubricant consumption, ship speed, and the main 
engine rotational speed. If there is any abnormal or unconformity, inquire the ship immediately, find out 
the cause and propose a solution. 
4.5 机务总管负责安排船舶所申请润料的供应；按照要求定期提醒轮机长安排润料的化验，
对化验结果做出技术分析并及时反馈给轮机长；如果发现化验报告指标超出正常值，
立即和部门经理等一起分析原因，将分析的结果和需要采取的措施反馈给轮机长，并
监督轮机长实施。 
The technical superintendent is responsible for arranging the supply of the lubricants for the ship, 
reminding the Chief Engineer to arrange the analysis of the lubricants regularly according to requirement, 
and making technical analysis of the result and feed it back to the Chief Engineer. If the test result is out 
of range, make analysis with the department manager immediately and feed back the result and the 
measures needing to take to the Chief Engineer,  and supervise the implementation of Chief Engineer. 
4.6 与航运部门保持联系，对拟进入特殊区域的船舶，低硫油的加装、转换和使用进行技
术指导和监督。 
Keep contact with the shipping department, provide technical guidance and supervise the bunkering, 
transferring and using of low sulphur fuel for the ship planned to entering special areas. 
5.0 档案的建立  
File creation 
机务人员要对各种机务报告、登轮检查报告、缺陷记录以及船舶修理记录分别建档。 
The technical superintendent shall record and create file for the technical reports separately, the boarding 
inspection report, the defect record and the ship repair record. 
6.0 SMIS 查阅 
SMIS review 
机务人员针对已配备SMIS 系统的船舶要每天及时查阅SMIS 所列的详细内容，及时处
理船舶提出的要求并反馈船舶。 
 
The technical superintendent shall consult the detailed contents listed by SMIS in time for the ship 
equipped with SMIS system and deal with the request of the ship and give feedback to the ship in time. 
7.0 相关文件  
Related documents 
《关键性设备和系统的标识程序》 
Identification Program of Key Equipment and System 
《船舶预防性维护程序》

Ship Inspection and Supervision Procedures

03_32.chapter: 第十六章 船员报销制度
03_32.text:
第十六章 船员报销制度 
Chapter 16 Crew Reimbursement Regulations 
 
1 
总则General principles 
为规范中国籍船员费用的报销，制定以下报销制度。外籍船员费用报销，归外籍船
员公司负责。 
To standardize the reimbursement of expenses for Chinese crews, the following reimbursement policy 
is established. Expenses for foreign crews fall under the responsibility of the foreign crew company. 
2 
船员上船集结费用Expenses reimbursement of boarding crew 
2.1 
报销范围Reimbursement coverage 
船员部按照工作需要，合理安排船员调动，公司承担船员的交通及食宿费用。 
The Crew Department, in accordance with the needs of work, arranges the transfer of the crew 
reasonably. The company undertakes the traffic、meal and hotel expenses for the crew. 
2.2 
报销标准如下Reimbursement standard is as follows: 
2.2.1 船长、轮机长、可报销飞机票经济舱或者动车二等座，其他职务船员报销火车硬座、
硬卧、动车二等座、客轮三等舱及以下等级、客车票。若船员自愿乘坐飞机，可按
火车票硬卧或动车二等座的标准给予报销，超出标准部分由个人负担；特殊情况需
乘坐飞机，须经船员部同意。 
Masters and Chief Engineers shall be reimbursed for economy class airfare or economy class ticket of 
CRH ，crew holding other ranks are eligible for train ticket of hard seat or semi-cushioned berth, 
economy class ticket of CRH, third or lower class ticket of passenger ship and bus ticket. If the crew 
would like to take the plane voluntarily, the traveling expenses will be reimbursed by the standard of 
semi-cushioned berth train ticket or the second class ticket of CRH. The overspent expenses shall be 
borne by the crew personally. The crew who needs to take the plane for exceptional situation, must 
apply for the approval of the Crew Department.  
2.2.2 船员自驾至集合地或返家可报销实际高速通行费，或按照相同起讫点报销城际公共
交通费（二者不可兼报）。 
Crew driving to report to the vessel or returning home by self-drive can be reimbursed for actual 
highway toll fees, or for intercity public transportation fares between the same origin and destination 
(but not both). 
2.2.3 船员选取长途拼车或者多名船员共同包车的方式上船/返家，可按照相同起讫点报销
城际公共交通费。 
Crew utilizing long-distance ride-sharing or group charter services to join the vessel/return home are 
eligible for reimbursement of intercity public transportation fares between identical origin-destination 
points. 
2.2.4 家住青岛市区的船员在公司培训期间，按照 30 元人民币/天的标准发放交通补贴。
Crew residing within the municipal urban of Qingdao shall be provided a daily transportation 
allowance of RMB 30 during company-mandated training periods. 
2.2.5 携带大件行李，出行时间较早/较晚，多人共同乘坐等情况，可乘坐出租车，其他日
常活动请乘坐公共交通工具。特殊情况下需长途乘坐出租车，先征得船员部同意。

管理须知手册                           版本/修改： 3.0/8.0                      INS-16  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/8.0                    INS-16

Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 2/3 
 
Taxi usage is permitted under special circumstances including transport of large luggage, off-peak 
hour travel, or when carrying multiple crew. For daily commuting, public transportation must be used. 
Long-distance taxi trips require prior approval from the Crewing Department. 
2.2.6 餐费补贴Meal allowance 
（1） 早餐：住宿宾馆提供Breakfast: supplied by hotel where the crew stay 
（2） 午餐、晚餐：在公司培训期间，工作日凭餐卡在餐厅用餐。在外就餐每餐补助30 元。
Lunch, Dinner: when training in company, the crew have the meal in the restaurant by meal card in 
working days. RMB30 per meal will subsidized for crew who needs to dine out. 
2.2.7 住宿费Hotel expenses 
（1） 公司船员部统一为船员预定房间，公司结算。 
The Crew Department of the company will book and settle down the hotel for the crew. 
（2） 船长、轮机长安排单间，其他职务安排标间。 
Arrange alone room for the Master and the Chief Engineer, and standard room for crew in other 
positions. 
（3） 住宿期间，除住宿费用外的船员个人消费由个人承担。 
Any personal charges beyond accommodation costs during hotel stays shall be covered by the crew 
concerned. 
（4） 在外地住宿每间不超过200 元/天。超标需征得船员部同意。 
The hotel expenses in other places shall be no more than RMB200 per day. Ask the permission from 
the Crew Department for overspent hotel expenses. 
2.2.8 公司报销船员的体检、防疫费用，以及由此产生的住宿费、路费。 
The Company shall cover seafarers' medical examination and vaccination costs, including associated 
accommodation and transportation expenses. 
2.2.9 公司安排的相关外部培训费用，实报实销。 
The cost of relevant external training arranged by the company shall be reimbursed based on the 
actual expenses. 
2.2.10 签约船员家属们访船交通费用，每年报销一次，实报实销，报销标准参2.2.1 船员报
销标准。 
Transportation expenses for contracted seafarers' dependents visiting vessels are reimbursable once 
annually for actual costs incurred, subject to the travel expense reimbursement standards specified in 
Clause 2.2.1. 
2.2.11 所有需要报销的发票必须提供原件，递交公司船员部。 
All invoices for reimbursement must be original and submitted to the crew department of the 
company. 
3 
证书更新培训费Reimbursement for certificate renewal 
3.1 
报销范围Reimbursement coverage 
签约船员的职务晋升，证书更新产生的考试、培训、交通、住宿等费用。 
The Company shall reimburse contracted seafarers for examination fees and essential training costs 
directly related to rank promotions or certificate renewals.  

管理须知手册                           版本/修改： 3.0/8.0                      INS-16  
Shorebase Instruction Manual               Version/Revise: 3.0/8.0                    INS-16  
青岛韦立国际船舶管理有限公司                             生效日期：2026/04/15               第3/3页 
Qingdao Winning International Ships Management Co., Ltd.         Effective Date: 2026/04/15            Page: 3/3 
 
3.2 
报销标准如下Reimbursement standard is as follows: 
3.2.1 参加管理级的适任证书晋升培训和考试的人员，其培训费和初次考试报名费由公司
报销，补考费用由个人承担。 
Crews undertaking management-level Certificate of Competency (CoC) upgrade training and 
examinations shall have their training fees and initial examination registration fees reimbursed by the 
Company，retake examination fees shall be borne by the individual.  
3.2.2 四小证更新培训，公司报销培训费、初试考试报名费，补考费用由个人承担。 
The Company reimburses Basic Safety Training (BST) renewal course fees and initial certification 
exam registration costs. Seafarers bear all retake examination fees. 
3.2.3 培训、考试期间的住宿补贴为￥30/天，报道日起算，考试完成日截止，最长不得超
过150 天，低于150 天根据实际情况计算补贴。 
An accommodation allowance of RMB 30 per calendar day shall be granted for periods between the 
reporting date and examination completion date during mandatory certification programs. The 
allowance is capped at 150 days per program cycle and disbursed proportionally based on verified 
attendance. 
3.2.4 整个培训考试期间，报销一次往返交通费。 
The company bears the expenses of a round trip during the training period。 
3.3 
费用返还Expenses refund 
签约船员中途解约离职，参加管理级适任证书晋升培训、考试，公司所报销的费用
需按5 年时间比例返还公司。 
Contracted seafarers who initiate early contract termination must provide pro-rata reimbursement for 
Company-sponsored management-level CoC upgrade training/examination costs, calculated according 
to the proportion of uncompleted service within the 60-month commitment period.

03_33.chapter: 第十七章 船舶招待费管理规定
03_33.text:
第十七章  船舶招待费管理规定 
Chapter 17  Ship’s Entertainment Expenses Management Regulation 
 
1.0 目的 
Purpose 
为加强港航协作，有利协调港口各有关部门的关系，特制定本规定。 
This procedure is hereby formulated to strengthen the cooperation between Port and Ship, and facilitate 
the coordination of the relationship between the relevant administration authority and ship. 
2.0 船舶招待费通常是针对港口有关部门和主管机关，船长在使用招待费上应厉行节约，
不超过标准，又要有的放矢。 
Ship entertainment expenses is usually spent for the related departments of port and the administration 
authorities. The master shall spend the entertainment expenses properly with objectives-oriented and shall 
not spend in excess of the standard.  
2.1 船长根据各部门的使用情况进行合理安排及分配。 
The master shall arrange and distribute the entertainment expenses properly according to the actual 
expense spending of each department. 
2.2 严禁船长将招待费私分和变相使用。 
Distributing the entertainment expenses secretly and spending the money in disguised form are strictly 
forbidden for the master.  
3.0 招待费标准： 
Standard of the entertainment expenses： 
3.1 货物装卸港、修船港、交接船港、加油停靠港的招待费标准按照管理公司有关规定执
行。 
The entertainment expenses standard for the port of loading and discharging, the port of repair, the port of 
delivery, and the port of call for bunkering shall be in accordance with the relevant provisions of the 
management company. 
3.2 特殊情况下招待费超支的，船长应事先征得相关主管的同意，并按照公司的指示使用
招待费。 
If the entertainment expenses are overspent in special circumstances, the master shall get approval from 
relevant superintendent in advance and spend the entertainment expenses in accordance with the 
instructions of the company.
